name: R56Audit.exists_candidate
statement:
lemma exists_candidate (w : Fin n → ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ o : Option (Fin n), ∀ i,
      (0 ≤ w i ∧ w i ≤ o.elim 0 (fun k => clampUnit (w k))) ↔ (0 ≤ w i ∧ w i ≤ x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hA : ∃ i, 0 ≤ w i ∧ w i ≤ x
  · have hne : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => 0 ≤ w i ∧ w i ≤ x)).Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hA
      exact ⟨i, by simp [hi]⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hmax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image _ w hne
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hk hmax
    refine ⟨some k, fun i => ?_⟩
    have hck : clampUnit (w k) = w k := clampUnit_of_mem ⟨hk.1, hk.2.trans hx.2⟩
    simp only [Option.elim_some, hck]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h0, h1⟩
      exact ⟨h0, h1.trans hk.2⟩
    · rintro ⟨h0, h1⟩
      exact ⟨h0, hmax i ⟨h0, h1⟩⟩
  · refine ⟨none, fun i => ?_⟩
    simp only [Option.elim_none]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h0, h1⟩
      exact absurd ⟨i, h0, h1.trans hx.1⟩ hA
    · intro h
      exact absurd ⟨i, h⟩ hA

name: R56Audit.F_congr
statement:
lemma F_congr (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) (P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ) {x x' y y' : ℝ}
    (hx : ∀ i, (0 ≤ (P i).1 ∧ (P i).1 ≤ x') ↔ (0 ≤ (P i).1 ∧ (P i).1 ≤ x))
    (hy : ∀ i, (0 ≤ (P i).2 ∧ (P i).2 ≤ y') ↔ (0 ≤ (P i).2 ∧ (P i).2 ≤ y)) :
    F χ P x' y' = F χ P x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [F_eq_filter, F_eq_filter]
  congr 1
  ext i
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a1, a2, a3, a4⟩
    exact ⟨((hx i).mp ⟨a1, a2⟩).1, ((hx i).mp ⟨a1, a2⟩).2,
      ((hy i).mp ⟨a3, a4⟩).1, ((hy i).mp ⟨a3, a4⟩).2⟩
  · rintro ⟨a1, a2, a3, a4⟩
    exact ⟨((hx i).mpr ⟨a1, a2⟩).1, ((hx i).mpr ⟨a1, a2⟩).2,
      ((hy i).mpr ⟨a3, a4⟩).1, ((hy i).mpr ⟨a3, a4⟩).2⟩

name: R56Audit.supNorm_eq_max
statement:
theorem supNorm_eq_max (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) (P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ) :
    supNorm χ P = ⨆ o : Option (Fin n) × Option (Fin n),
      |F χ P (candidateX o.1 P) (candidateY o.2 P)|
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [supNorm_le_iff]
    intro x hx y hy
    obtain ⟨o1, h1⟩ := exists_candidate (fun i => (P i).1) hx
    obtain ⟨o2, h2⟩ := exists_candidate (fun i => (P i).2) hy
    have h := F_congr χ P (x' := candidateX o1 P) (y' := candidateY o2 P) (x := x) (y := y)
      h1 h2
    rw [← h]
    exact le_ciSup (f := fun o : Option (Fin n) × Option (Fin n) =>
      |F χ P (candidateX o.1 P) (candidateY o.2 P)|) (Set.finite_range _).bddAbove (o1, o2)
  · exact ciSup_le fun o => le_supNorm χ P (candidateX_mem _ _) (candidateY_mem _ _)

name: R56Audit.exists_eq_supNorm
statement:
theorem exists_eq_supNorm (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) (P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ) :
    ∃ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, |F χ P x y| = supNorm χ P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨o, ho⟩ := exists_eq_ciSup_of_finite
    (f := fun o : Option (Fin n) × Option (Fin n) =>
      |F χ P (candidateX o.1 P) (candidateY o.2 P)|)
  exact ⟨_, candidateX_mem o.1 P, _, candidateY_mem o.2 P, by rw [supNorm_eq_max]; exact ho⟩

name: R56Audit.measurable_F_candidate
statement:
lemma measurable_F_candidate (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) (o1 o2 : Option (Fin n)) :
    Measurable (fun P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ => F χ P (candidateX o1 P) (candidateY o2 P))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [F_eq_filter, Finset.sum_filter]
  refine Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => ?_
  have hU : Measurable (fun P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ => (P i).1) := (measurable_pi_apply i).fst
  have hV : Measurable (fun P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ => (P i).2) := (measurable_pi_apply i).snd
  refine Measurable.ite ?_ measurable_const measurable_const
  exact (measurableSet_le measurable_const hU).inter
    ((measurableSet_le hU (measurable_candidateX o1)).inter
      ((measurableSet_le measurable_const hV).inter
        (measurableSet_le hV (measurable_candidateY o2))))

name: R56Audit.measurable_supNorm
statement: theorem measurable_supNorm (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) : Measurable (supNorm χ)
proof:
:= by
  have h : supNorm χ = fun P => ⨆ o : Option (Fin n) × Option (Fin n),
      |F χ P (candidateX o.1 P) (candidateY o.2 P)| :=
    funext (supNorm_eq_max χ)
  rw [h]
  exact Measurable.iSup fun o =>
    continuous_abs.measurable.comp (measurable_F_candidate χ o.1 o.2)

name: R56Audit.measurableSet_forall_le_supNorm
statement:
theorem measurableSet_forall_le_supNorm (t : ℝ) :
    MeasurableSet {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ | ∀ χ : Fin n → ℤˣ, t ≤ supNorm χ P}
proof:
:= by
  have h : {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ | ∀ χ : Fin n → ℤˣ, t ≤ supNorm χ P} =
      ⋂ χ : Fin n → ℤˣ, {P | t ≤ supNorm χ P} := by
    ext P
    simp
  rw [h]
  exact MeasurableSet.iInter fun χ => measurableSet_le measurable_const (measurable_supNorm χ)

name: R56Audit.measurableSet_supNorm_le
statement:
theorem measurableSet_supNorm_le (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) (B : ℝ) :
    MeasurableSet {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ | supNorm χ P ≤ B}
proof:
:=
  measurableSet_le (measurable_supNorm χ) measurable_const

name: R56Audit.measurableSet_exists_supNorm_le
statement:
theorem measurableSet_exists_supNorm_le (B : ℝ) :
    MeasurableSet {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ | ∃ χ : Fin n → ℤˣ, supNorm χ P ≤ B}
proof:
:= by
  have h : {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ | ∃ χ : Fin n → ℤˣ, supNorm χ P ≤ B} =
      ⋃ χ : Fin n → ℤˣ, {P | supNorm χ P ≤ B} := by
    ext P
    simp
  rw [h]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun χ => measurableSet_supNorm_le χ B

name: R56Audit.one_le_supNorm
statement:
theorem one_le_supNorm (hn : 1 ≤ n) (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) (P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ i, (P i).1 ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ (P i).2 ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hinj : Function.Injective fun i => (P i).2) : 1 ≤ supNorm χ P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨t₀, -, hmin⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))
    (fun i => (P i).2) ⟨⟨0, hn⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
  
  have hfilter : Finset.univ.filter (fun t => 0 ≤ (P t).1 ∧ (P t).1 ≤ 1 ∧
      0 ≤ (P t).2 ∧ (P t).2 ≤ (P t₀).2) = {t₀} := by
    ext t
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨-, -, -, h4⟩
      exact hinj (le_antisymm h4 (hmin t (Finset.mem_univ t)))
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨(hP t).1.1, (hP t).1.2, (hP t).2.1, le_rfl⟩
  have h := le_supNorm χ P (x := 1) (y := (P t₀).2) (by simp) (hP t₀).2
  rw [F_eq_filter, hfilter, Finset.sum_singleton] at h
  have h1 : |(((χ t₀ : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ)| = 1 := by
    rcases Int.units_eq_one_or (χ t₀) with h' | h' <;> simp [h']
  rw [h1] at h
  exact h

name: R56Audit.measurable_digit
statement: lemma measurable_digit (b k : ℕ) : Measurable (digit b k)
proof:
:=
  (measurable_of_countable fun m : ℕ => m % b).comp
    (measurable_const.mul measurable_id).nat_floor

name: R56Audit.measurable_digitInfo
statement: lemma measurable_digitInfo (n b j : ℕ) : Measurable (digitInfo n b j)
proof:
:= by
  refine Measurable.prodMk (measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun i => ?_)
    (measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun i => measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun k => ?_)
  · exact measurable_snd.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  · exact (measurable_digit b ((k : ℕ) + 1)).comp (measurable_fst.comp (measurable_pi_apply i))

name: R56Audit.fresh_eq_digit
statement:
theorem fresh_eq_digit {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (k : ℕ) {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u)
    (hgrid : ∀ (m : ℤ) (r : ℕ), u ≠ (m : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ r) :
    (freshGridIndex (b ^ k) b hb u : ℕ) = digit b (k + 1) u
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : (0 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) := pow_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hb) _
  
  have hceil : ⌈(b : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * u⌉ = ⌊(b : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * u⌋ + 1 := by
    rw [Int.ceil_eq_floor_add_one_iff_notMem]
    rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
    refine hgrid m (k + 1) ?_
    rw [hm]
    exact (mul_div_cancel_left₀ u hpow.ne').symm
  
  have hidx : gridIndex (b ^ k * b) u = ⌊(b : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * u⌋ := by
    unfold gridIndex
    rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow, ← pow_succ, hceil, add_sub_cancel_right]
  
  apply Nat.cast_injective (R := ℤ)
  rw [freshGridIndex_eq_emod (b ^ k) b (pow_pos hb k) hb u, hidx, digit, Int.natCast_emod,
    Int.natCast_floor_eq_floor (mul_pos hpow hu).le]

name: R56Audit.idxOfDigits_succ
statement:
lemma idxOfDigits_succ (b j : ℕ) (d : Fin (j + 1) → ℕ) :
    idxOfDigits b (j + 1) d =
      (b : ℤ) * idxOfDigits b j (fun k => d k.castSucc) + (d (Fin.last j) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold idxOfDigits
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [Fin.val_castSucc, Nat.sub_add_comm (Nat.succ_le_of_lt k.isLt), pow_succ', mul_assoc]
  · rw [Fin.val_last, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, one_mul]

name: R56Audit.gridIndex_eq_idxOfDigits
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    
    have h := gridIndex_bounds 1 one_pos hu
    have h0 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ gridIndex 1 u := by exact_mod_cast h.1
    have h1 : gridIndex 1 u + 1 ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast h.2
    rw [pow_zero, idxOfDigits, Fin.sum_univ_zero]
    omega
  | succ j ih =>
    
    rw [gridIndex_succ hb, ih, fresh_eq_digit hb j hu.1 hgrid, idxOfDigits_succ b j]
    rfl

name: R56Audit.digit_eq_digitsOfIdx
statement:
lemma digit_eq_digitsOfIdx {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (j : ℕ) {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u)
    (hgrid : ∀ (m : ℤ) (r : ℕ), u ≠ (m : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ r) (k : Fin j) :
    digit b ((k : ℕ) + 1) u = digitsOfIdx b j (gridIndex (b ^ j) u) k
proof:
:= by
  
  have h1 := gridIndex_mul_ediv (b ^ ((k : ℕ) + 1)) (b ^ (j - ((k : ℕ) + 1))) (pow_pos hb _) u
  rw [pow_mul_pow_sub b (Nat.succ_le_of_lt k.isLt), Nat.cast_pow] at h1
  
  have h2 := freshGridIndex_eq_emod (b ^ (k : ℕ)) b (pow_pos hb _) hb u
  rw [← pow_succ] at h2
  rw [digitsOfIdx, h1, ← h2, Int.toNat_natCast, fresh_eq_digit hb k hu hgrid]

name: R56Audit.measurable_coarseOfDigits
statement: lemma measurable_coarseOfDigits (n b j : ℕ) : Measurable (coarseOfDigits n b j)
proof:
:=
  measurable_fst.prodMk ((measurable_of_countable
    (fun d : Fin n → Fin j → ℕ => fun i => idxOfDigits b j (d i))).comp measurable_snd)

name: R56Audit.measurable_digitsOfCoarse
statement: lemma measurable_digitsOfCoarse (n b j : ℕ) : Measurable (digitsOfCoarse n b j)
proof:
:=
  measurable_fst.prodMk ((measurable_of_countable
    (fun g : Fin n → ℤ => fun i => digitsOfIdx b j (g i))).comp measurable_snd)

name: R56Audit.coarseInfo_ae_eq_digitInfo
statement:
theorem coarseInfo_ae_eq_digitInfo {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (n j : ℕ) :
    coarseInfo n (b ^ j) =ᵐ[unifPts n] coarseOfDigits n b j ∘ digitInfo n b j
proof:
:= by
  
  filter_upwards [ae_inUnit n, ae_noGrid n b] with P hP hgrid
  exact Prod.ext rfl (funext fun i =>
    gridIndex_eq_idxOfDigits hb j (hP i).1 fun m r => (hgrid i m r).1)

name: R56Audit.digitInfo_ae_eq_coarseInfo
statement:
theorem digitInfo_ae_eq_coarseInfo {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (n j : ℕ) :
    digitInfo n b j =ᵐ[unifPts n] digitsOfCoarse n b j ∘ coarseInfo n (b ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  
  filter_upwards [ae_inUnit n, ae_noGrid n b] with P hP hgrid
  exact Prod.ext rfl (funext fun i => funext fun k =>
    digit_eq_digitsOfIdx hb j (hP i).1.1 (fun m r => (hgrid i m r).1) k)

name: R56Audit.condExp_digitSigma
statement:
theorem condExp_digitSigma {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (j : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ) :
    (unifPts n)[f | digitSigma n b j] =ᵐ[unifPts n] (unifPts n)[f | stageSigma n b j]
proof:
:=
  
  
  condExp_comap_congr_ae (measurable_digitInfo n b j) (measurable_coarseInfo n (b ^ j))
    (measurable_coarseOfDigits n b j) (measurable_digitsOfCoarse n b j)
    (coarseInfo_ae_eq_digitInfo hb n j) (digitInfo_ae_eq_coarseInfo hb n j) f

name: R56Audit.lemma_2_4_digits
statement:
theorem lemma_2_4_digits {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hj : j < h) (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) :
    ∀ᵐ P ∂unifPts n, delta b h j P ≤
      ((unifPts n)[fun P => Zpot χ b h (j + 1) P - Zpot χ b h j P | digitSigma n b j]) P
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by omega
  
  filter_upwards [lemma_2_4 hb hj χ, condExp_digitSigma hb0 j
    (fun P => Zpot χ b h (j + 1) P - Zpot χ b h j P)] with P hP hdig
  exact hP.trans_eq hdig.symm

name: R56Audit.fluctDigits_ae_eq
statement:
theorem fluctDigits_ae_eq {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h : ℕ) (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) :
    fluctDigits χ b h =ᵐ[unifPts n] fluct χ b h
proof:
:= by
  
  have hall : ∀ᵐ P ∂unifPts n, ∀ j ∈ Finset.range h,
      ((unifPts n)[Zpot χ b h (j + 1) | digitSigma n b j]) P =
        ((unifPts n)[Zpot χ b h (j + 1) | stageSigma n b j]) P :=
    (ae_ball_iff (Finset.range h).countable_toSet).mpr fun j _ =>
      condExp_digitSigma hb j (Zpot χ b h (j + 1))
  filter_upwards [hall] with P hP
  unfold fluctDigits fluct
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => by rw [hP j hj]

name: R56Audit.lemma_2_6_digits
statement:
theorem lemma_2_6_digits {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h : ℕ) (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) {lam : ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam) :
    (unifPts n).real {P | fluctDigits χ b h P ≤ -lam} ≤
      Real.exp (-(lam ^ 2 * ((b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1)) ^ 2 / (2 * h * n)))
proof:
:= by
  
  have hsets : {P | fluctDigits χ b h P ≤ -lam} =ᵐ[unifPts n] {P | fluct χ b h P ≤ -lam} := by
    filter_upwards [fluctDigits_ae_eq hb h χ] with P hP
    rw [hP]
  rw [measureReal_congr hsets]
  exact lemma_2_6 hb h χ hlam

name: R56Audit.roadmap_digits
statement:
theorem roadmap_digits {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h : ℕ) (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) :
    ∀ᵐ P ∂unifPts n, Zpot χ b h h P = Zpot χ b h 0 P +
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range h,
        ((unifPts n)[fun P => Zpot χ b h (j + 1) P - Zpot χ b h j P | digitSigma n b j]) P +
      fluctDigits χ b h P
proof:
:= by
  
  have hall : ∀ᵐ P ∂unifPts n, ∀ j ∈ Finset.range h,
      ((unifPts n)[fun P => Zpot χ b h (j + 1) P - Zpot χ b h j P | digitSigma n b j]) P =
        ((unifPts n)[fun P => Zpot χ b h (j + 1) P - Zpot χ b h j P | stageSigma n b j]) P :=
    (ae_ball_iff (Finset.range h).countable_toSet).mpr fun j _ =>
      condExp_digitSigma hb j fun P => Zpot χ b h (j + 1) P - Zpot χ b h j P
  
  filter_upwards [roadmap hb h χ, hall, fluctDigits_ae_eq hb h χ] with P hP hgain hfluct
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hgain, hfluct]
  exact hP

name: R56Audit.Zpot_aestronglyMeasurable_digits
statement:
theorem Zpot_aestronglyMeasurable_digits {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hj : j ≤ h) (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[digitSigma n b j] (Zpot χ b h j) (unifPts n)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have hmeas : Measurable[digitSigma n b j] (fun P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ =>
      Zstep (sgn χ) b h j (coarseOfDigits n b j (digitInfo n b j P)).1
        (coarseOfDigits n b j (digitInfo n b j P)).2) :=
    ((measurable_Zstep_uncurry hb (sgn χ) h j).comp (measurable_coarseOfDigits n b j)).comp
      (comap_measurable (digitInfo n b j))
  refine ⟨_, hmeas.stronglyMeasurable, ?_⟩
  
  have hZ := Zpot_ae_eq_Zproc hb hj χ
  rw [pointSampleLaw_eq_unifPts] at hZ
  filter_upwards [hZ, coarseInfo_ae_eq_digitInfo hb n j] with P hP hc
  rw [hP, Zproc_eq hj, hc]
  rfl

name: R56Audit.measurable_nextDigits
statement: lemma measurable_nextDigits {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (n j : ℕ) : Measurable (nextDigits hb n j)
proof:
:= by
  refine measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun i => ?_
  
  have hmod : Measurable (fun m : ℕ => (⟨m % b, Nat.mod_lt m hb⟩ : Fin b)) :=
    measurable_of_countable _
  have hfloor : Measurable (fun u : ℝ => ⌊(b : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) * u⌋₊) :=
    (measurable_const.mul measurable_id).nat_floor
  exact (hmod.comp hfloor).comp (measurable_fst.comp (measurable_pi_apply i))

name: R56Audit.nextDigits_ae_eq_freshInfo
statement:
theorem nextDigits_ae_eq_freshInfo {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (n j : ℕ) :
    nextDigits hb n j =ᵐ[unifPts n] freshInfo n (b ^ j) b hb
proof:
:= by
  
  filter_upwards [ae_inUnit n, ae_noGrid n b] with P hP hgrid
  exact funext fun i => Fin.ext
    (fresh_eq_digit hb j (hP i).1.1 fun m r => (hgrid i m r).1).symm

name: R56Audit.condExp_nextDigits
statement:
theorem condExp_nextDigits {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (n j : ℕ)
    (H : (Fin n → ℝ) × (Fin n → Fin j → ℕ) → (Fin n → Fin b) → ℝ)
    (hH : ∀ r, Measurable fun p => H p r) (K : ℝ) (hK : ∀ p r, |H p r| ≤ K) :
    (unifPts n)[fun P => H (digitInfo n b j P) (nextDigits hb n j P) | digitSigma n b j]
      =ᵐ[unifPts n] fun P => finAvg (fun r => H (digitInfo n b j P) r)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have key := condExp_fresh_given_heights n (b ^ j) b (pow_pos hb j) hb
    (fun p r => H (digitsOfCoarse n b j p) r)
    (fun r => (hH r).comp (measurable_digitsOfCoarse n b j)) K fun p r => hK _ r
  rw [pointSampleLaw_eq_unifPts] at key
  
  
  have hfun : (fun P => H (digitInfo n b j P) (nextDigits hb n j P)) =ᵐ[unifPts n]
      fun P => H (digitsOfCoarse n b j (coarseInfo n (b ^ j) P))
        (freshInfo n (b ^ j) b hb P) := by
    filter_upwards [digitInfo_ae_eq_coarseInfo hb n j, nextDigits_ae_eq_freshInfo hb n j]
      with P hd hr
    rw [hd, hr]
    rfl
  have havg : (fun P => finAvg (fun r => H (digitsOfCoarse n b j (coarseInfo n (b ^ j) P)) r))
      =ᵐ[unifPts n] fun P => finAvg (fun r => H (digitInfo n b j P) r) := by
    filter_upwards [digitInfo_ae_eq_coarseInfo hb n j] with P hd
    rw [hd]
    rfl
  
  exact (condExp_digitSigma hb j _).trans ((condExp_congr_ae hfun).trans (key.trans havg))

name: R56Audit.abs_sgn
statement: lemma abs_sgn (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) (i : Fin n) : |sgn χ i| = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.units_eq_one_or (χ i) with h | h <;> simp [sgn, h]

name: R56Audit.sideOf_eq_inside_iff
statement:
lemma sideOf_eq_inside_iff {xm xp u : ℝ} :
    sideOf xm xp u = Side.inside ↔ xm < u ∧ u ≤ xp
proof:
:= by
  unfold sideOf
  split_ifs with h1 h2
  · simp [not_lt.mpr h1]
  · simp [not_le.mp h1, h2]
  · simp [h2]

name: R56Audit.F_eq_sum_ite
statement:
lemma F_eq_sum_ite (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) (P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ i, 0 ≤ (P i).1 ∧ 0 ≤ (P i).2) (x y : ℝ) :
    F χ P x y = ∑ i, if (P i).2 ≤ y then (if (P i).1 ≤ x then sgn χ i else 0) else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [F_eq_filter, Finset.sum_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  have h1 := (hP i).1
  have h2 := (hP i).2
  by_cases hy : (P i).2 ≤ y
  · by_cases hx : (P i).1 ≤ x
    · simp [hy, hx, h1, h2, sgn]
    · simp [hy, hx]
  · simp [hy]

name: R56Audit.endpointAvg_eq_F
statement:
theorem endpointAvg_eq_F (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) (P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ i, 0 ≤ (P i).1 ∧ 0 ≤ (P i).2) {xm xp : ℝ} (hx : xm ≤ xp) (y : ℝ) :
    (F χ P xm y + F χ P xp y) / 2 =
      endpointAvg (sgn χ) (fun i => (P i).2) (fun i => sideOf xm xp (P i).1) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [F_eq_sum_ite χ P hP, F_eq_sum_ite χ P hP, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_div]
  unfold endpointAvg stepFn
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  by_cases hy : (P i).2 ≤ y
  · simp only [hy, ite_true]
    unfold sideOf
    by_cases h1 : (P i).1 ≤ xm
    · have h2 : (P i).1 ≤ xp := h1.trans hx
      simp [h1, h2, oldWeight]
    · by_cases h2 : (P i).1 ≤ xp
      · simp [h1, h2, oldWeight]
        ring
      · simp [h1, h2, oldWeight]
  · simp [hy]

name: R56Audit.exists_childIndex
statement:
lemma exists_childIndex {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) {xm xp u : ℝ} (hu : xm < u ∧ u ≤ xp) :
    ∃ r : Fin b, xm + (r : ℕ) * ((xp - xm) / b) < u ∧
      u ≤ xm + ((r : ℕ) + 1) * ((xp - xm) / b)
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hw : 0 < (xp - xm) / b := div_pos (by linarith) hbR
  have hfull : (b : ℝ) * ((xp - xm) / b) = xp - xm := by field_simp
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, u - xm = t * ((xp - xm) / b) :=
    ⟨(u - xm) / ((xp - xm) / b), (div_mul_cancel₀ _ hw.ne').symm⟩
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by
    by_contra h
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (not_lt.mp h) hw.le
    linarith
  have htb : t ≤ b := by
    by_contra h
    have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (not_le.mp h) hw
    linarith
  have hceil_pos : 0 < ⌈t⌉₊ := Nat.ceil_pos.mpr ht0
  have hceil_le : ⌈t⌉₊ ≤ b := Nat.ceil_le.mpr htb
  have hc : ((⌈t⌉₊ - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (⌈t⌉₊ : ℝ) - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hceil_pos, Nat.cast_one]
  refine ⟨⟨⌈t⌉₊ - 1, by omega⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 : ((⌈t⌉₊ - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) < t := by
      rw [hc]
      linarith [Nat.ceil_lt_add_one ht0.le]
    have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h1 hw
    simp only
    linarith
  · have h2 : t ≤ ((⌈t⌉₊ - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by
      rw [hc]
      linarith [Nat.le_ceil t]
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 hw.le
    simp only
    linarith

name: R56Audit.childAvg_eq_F
statement:
theorem childAvg_eq_F {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) (P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ i, 0 ≤ (P i).1 ∧ 0 ≤ (P i).2) {xm xp : ℝ} (hx : xm < xp) (r : Fin n → Fin b)
    (hr : ∀ i, xm < (P i).1 ∧ (P i).1 ≤ xp →
      xm + (r i : ℕ) * ((xp - xm) / b) < (P i).1 ∧
        (P i).1 ≤ xm + ((r i : ℕ) + 1) * ((xp - xm) / b))
    (k : Fin b) (y : ℝ) :
    (F χ P (xm + (k : ℕ) * ((xp - xm) / b)) y +
        F χ P (xm + ((k : ℕ) + 1) * ((xp - xm) / b)) y) / 2 =
      childAvg (sgn χ) (fun i => (P i).2) (fun i => sideOf xm xp (P i).1) r k y
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hw : 0 < (xp - xm) / b := div_pos (by linarith) hbR
  have hk0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℕ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hk1 : ((k : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast k.isLt
  have hfull : (b : ℝ) * ((xp - xm) / b) = xp - xm := by field_simp
  rw [F_eq_sum_ite χ P hP, F_eq_sum_ite χ P hP, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_div]
  unfold childAvg stepFn
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  by_cases hy : (P i).2 ≤ y
  · simp only [hy, ite_true]
    by_cases h1 : (P i).1 ≤ xm
    · 
      have ha : (P i).1 ≤ xm + (k : ℕ) * ((xp - xm) / b) := by nlinarith
      have hb' : (P i).1 ≤ xm + ((k : ℕ) + 1) * ((xp - xm) / b) := by nlinarith
      simp [sideOf, h1, ha, hb', childWeight]
    · by_cases h2 : (P i).1 ≤ xp
      · 
        obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := hr i ⟨not_le.mp h1, h2⟩
        have hside : sideOf xm xp (P i).1 = Side.inside := by simp [sideOf, h1, h2]
        simp only [hside, childWeight]
        rcases lt_trichotomy (r i) k with hlt | heq | hgt
        · have hlt' : ((r i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (k : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hlt
          have ha : (P i).1 ≤ xm + (k : ℕ) * ((xp - xm) / b) := by nlinarith
          have hb' : (P i).1 ≤ xm + ((k : ℕ) + 1) * ((xp - xm) / b) := by nlinarith
          simp [hlt, ha, hb']
        · have ha : ¬ (P i).1 ≤ xm + (k : ℕ) * ((xp - xm) / b) := by
            rw [← heq]; exact not_le.mpr hlo
          have hb' : (P i).1 ≤ xm + ((k : ℕ) + 1) * ((xp - xm) / b) := by
            rw [← heq]; exact hhi
          simp [heq, ha, hb']
          ring
        · have hgt' : ((k : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (r i : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hgt
          have ha : ¬ (P i).1 ≤ xm + (k : ℕ) * ((xp - xm) / b) := by
            apply not_le.mpr; nlinarith
          have hb' : ¬ (P i).1 ≤ xm + ((k : ℕ) + 1) * ((xp - xm) / b) := by
            apply not_le.mpr; nlinarith
          have hne : r i ≠ k := ne_of_gt hgt
          simp [not_lt.mpr hgt.le, hne, ha, hb']
      · 
        have h2' : xp < (P i).1 := not_le.mp h2
        have ha : ¬ (P i).1 ≤ xm + (k : ℕ) * ((xp - xm) / b) := by
          apply not_le.mpr; nlinarith
        have hb' : ¬ (P i).1 ≤ xm + ((k : ℕ) + 1) * ((xp - xm) / b) := by
          apply not_le.mpr; nlinarith
        simp [sideOf, h1, h2, ha, hb', childWeight]
  · simp [hy]

name: R56Audit.boolSign_colorBool
statement:
lemma boolSign_colorBool (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) (i : Fin n) :
    PointSets.boolSign (colorBool χ i) = ((χ i : ℤˣ) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.units_eq_one_or (χ i) with h | h <;> simp [colorBool, PointSets.boolSign, h]

name: R56Audit.colorBool_surjective
statement: lemma colorBool_surjective : Function.Surjective (colorBool (n := n))
proof:
:= by
  intro c
  refine ⟨fun i => if c i then 1 else -1, ?_⟩
  funext i
  cases hc : c i <;> simp [colorBool, hc]

name: R56Audit.exists_pointColoring
statement:
lemma exists_pointColoring (P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ) (hP : Function.Injective P)
    (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) :
    ∃ χ' : ↥(Finset.univ.image P) → ℤˣ,
      ∀ x y : ℝ, (colorSum (Finset.univ.image P) χ' (Set.Icc 0 (x, y)) : ℝ) = F χ P x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmem : ∀ p : ↥(Finset.univ.image P), ∃ t, P t = p := fun p => by
    obtain ⟨t, -, ht⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp p.2
    exact ⟨t, ht⟩
  refine ⟨fun p => χ (hmem p).choose, fun x y => ?_⟩
  have hkey : ∀ t,
      (hmem ⟨P t, Finset.mem_image_of_mem P (Finset.mem_univ t)⟩).choose = t := fun t =>
    hP (hmem ⟨P t, Finset.mem_image_of_mem P (Finset.mem_univ t)⟩).choose_spec
  have h := colorSum_image P hP (fun p => χ (hmem p).choose)
    (fun p => 0 ≤ p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ x ∧ 0 ≤ p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ y)
  rw [Icc_zero_eq, h, F_eq_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ => ?_
  rw [hkey t]

name: R56Audit.goodEvent_supNorm
statement:
lemma goodEvent_supNorm {b ε : ℝ} (h : GoodEvent n b ε) :
    ∃ G : Set (Fin n → ℝ × ℝ), MeasurableSet G ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (1 - ε) ≤ unifPts n G ∧
      ∀ P ∈ G, Function.Injective P ∧ ∀ χ : Fin n → ℤˣ, b < supNorm χ P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, hG, hmeas, hgood⟩ := h
  refine ⟨G, hG, hmeas, fun P hP => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hcard, hχ⟩ := hgood P hP
  have hinj : Function.Injective P := by
    have hc' : (Finset.univ.image P).card = (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).card := by
      rw [hcard]; simp
    have := Finset.card_image_iff.mp hc'
    intro i j hij
    exact this (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_univ i)) (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_univ j)) hij
  refine ⟨hinj, fun χ => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨χ', hχ'⟩ := exists_pointColoring P hinj χ
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩ := hχ χ'
  rw [hχ' x y] at hxy
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hxy (le_supNorm χ P hx hy)

name: R56Audit.lt_Δ₂_of_supNorm
statement:
theorem lt_Δ₂_of_supNorm {t : ℝ} (P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ) (hP : Function.Injective P)
    (h : ∀ χ : Fin n → ℤˣ, t < supNorm χ P) : t < Δ₂ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcard : (Finset.univ.image P).card = n := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hP]
    simp
  refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ (Nat.cast_le.mpr (rectDisc_le_Δ₂ hcard))
  apply lt_rectDisc
  intro χ'
  have hF : ∀ x y : ℝ, (colorSum (Finset.univ.image P) χ' (Set.Icc 0 (x, y)) : ℝ) =
      F (fun i => χ' ⟨P i, Finset.mem_image_of_mem P (Finset.mem_univ i)⟩) P x y := by
    intro x y
    rw [Icc_zero_eq, colorSum_image P hP χ'
      (fun p => 0 ≤ p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ x ∧ 0 ≤ p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ y), F_eq_filter]
  have : Nonempty (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 × Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
    ⟨(⟨0, by simp⟩, ⟨0, by simp⟩)⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_lt_of_lt_ciSup
    (h fun i => χ' ⟨P i, Finset.mem_image_of_mem P (Finset.mem_univ i)⟩)
  exact ⟨0, ((z.1 : ℝ), (z.2 : ℝ)), by rw [hF]; exact hz⟩

name: R56Audit.supNorm_le_eq_fixedColorBad
statement:
lemma supNorm_le_eq_fixedColorBad (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) (B : ℝ) :
    {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ | supNorm χ P ≤ B} = fixedColorBad n B (colorBool χ)
proof:
:= by
  ext P
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, supNorm_le_iff, fixedColorBad]
  constructor
  · intro h x hx y hy
    have := h x hx y hy
    rw [F_eq_filter] at this
    simpa only [boolSign_colorBool] using this
  · intro h x hx y hy
    rw [F_eq_filter]
    have := h x hx y hy
    simpa only [boolSign_colorBool] using this

name: R56Audit.exists_supNorm_le_eq_badSet
statement:
theorem exists_supNorm_le_eq_badSet (n : ℕ) (B : ℝ) :
    {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ | ∃ χ : Fin n → ℤˣ, supNorm χ P ≤ B} = badSet n B
proof:
:= by
  rw [badSet_eq_iUnion_fixedColorBad]
  ext P
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨χ, hχ⟩
    refine ⟨colorBool χ, ?_⟩
    rw [← supNorm_le_eq_fixedColorBad]
    exact hχ
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    obtain ⟨χ, rfl⟩ := colorBool_surjective c
    refine ⟨χ, ?_⟩
    rw [← supNorm_le_eq_fixedColorBad] at hc
    exact hc

name: R56Audit.mem_hcell
statement:
lemma mem_hcell {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) {j c : ℕ} {x : ℝ} :
    x ∈ hcell b j c ↔ (c : ℝ) ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ j * x ∧ (b : ℝ) ^ j * x ≤ (c : ℝ) + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpj : (0 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ j := by positivity
  rw [hcell, Set.mem_Icc, div_le_iff₀ hpj, le_div_iff₀ hpj, mul_comm x]

name: R56Audit.hcell_subset_unit
statement:
lemma hcell_subset_unit {b j c : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hc : c < b ^ j) :
    hcell b j c ⊆ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpj : (0 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ j := by positivity
  have hc1 : (c : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ j := by exact_mod_cast hc
  rintro x ⟨h1, h2⟩
  exact ⟨le_trans (by positivity) h1, h2.trans ((div_le_one hpj).mpr hc1)⟩

name: R56Audit.iUnion_hcell
statement:
theorem iUnion_hcell {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (j : ℕ) :
    ⋃ c : Fin (b ^ j), hcell b j c = Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact Set.iUnion_subset fun c => hcell_subset_unit hb c.isLt
  · 
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hxc⟩ := exists_hcell hb j hx
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨c, hc⟩, hxc⟩

name: R56Audit.volume_hcell
statement:
theorem volume_hcell {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (j c : ℕ) :
    volume (hcell b j c) = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (b : ℝ) ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hcell, Real.volume_Icc]
  congr 1
  field_simp
  ring

name: R56Audit.iUnion_vcell
statement:
theorem iUnion_vcell {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hj : j ≤ h) :
    ⋃ v : Fin (b ^ (h - j)), vcell b h j v = Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact Set.iUnion_subset fun v => vcell_subset_unit hb hj v.isLt
  · 
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hyw⟩ := exists_vcell hb hj hy
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, hyw⟩

name: R56Audit.volume_vcell
statement:
theorem volume_vcell {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h j v : ℕ) :
    volume (vcell b h j v) = ENNReal.ofReal ((b : ℝ) ^ j / (b : ℝ) ^ h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [vcell, Real.volume_Ico, vlen]
  congr 1
  field_simp
  ring

name: R56Audit.vcell_disjoint
statement:
theorem vcell_disjoint {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h j : ℕ) {v v' : ℕ} (hv : v ≠ v') :
    Disjoint (vcell b h j v) (vcell b h j v')
proof:
:= by
  
  have e : ∀ w : ℕ, vcell b h j w = block 0 (vlen b h j) w := by
    intro w
    unfold vcell block
    rw [zero_add, zero_add]
  rw [e v, e v']
  exact block_disjoint 0 (vlen_pos hb h j) hv

name: R56Audit.hcell_eq_iUnion_children
statement:
theorem hcell_eq_iUnion_children {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (j c : ℕ) :
    hcell b j c = ⋃ k : Fin b, hcell b (j + 1) (b * c + k)
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, mem_hcell hb, pow_succ, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hk1, hk2⟩ := exists_hcell hb 1 (x := (b : ℝ) ^ j * x - c)
      ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    rw [pow_one] at hk hk1 hk2
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hbR] at hk1
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hbR] at hk2
    exact ⟨⟨k, hk⟩, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, h1, h2⟩
    
    have hk1 : ((k : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast k.isLt
    exact ⟨le_of_mul_le_mul_left (by linarith) hbR, le_of_mul_le_mul_left (by linarith) hbR⟩

name: R56Audit.vcell_succ_eq_iUnion
statement:
theorem vcell_succ_eq_iUnion {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h j v : ℕ) :
    vcell b h (j + 1) v = ⋃ ℓ : Fin b, vcell b h j (b * v + ℓ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [vcell_succ_eq, ← iUnion_block _ (vlen_pos hb h j) b]
  exact Set.iUnion_congr fun ℓ => (vcell_eq_block b h j v ℓ).symm

name: R56Audit.iUnion_cell
statement:
theorem iUnion_cell {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hj : j ≤ h) :
    ⋃ c : Fin (b ^ j), ⋃ v : Fin (b ^ (h - j)), cell b h j c v =
      Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [← iUnion_hcell hb j, ← iUnion_vcell hb hj, Set.iUnion_prod_const]
  exact Set.iUnion_congr fun c => Set.prod_iUnion.symm

name: R56Audit.card_cells_stage
statement:
theorem card_cells_stage {b h j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ h) :
    Fintype.card (Fin (b ^ j) × Fin (b ^ (h - j))) = b ^ h
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin, ← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hj]

name: R56Audit.volume_cell
statement:
theorem volume_cell {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h j c v : ℕ) :
    volume (cell b h j c v) = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (b : ℝ) ^ h)
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [cell, Measure.volume_eq_prod, Measure.prod_prod, volume_hcell hb, volume_vcell hb,
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
  congr 1
  field_simp

name: R56Audit.compRect_eq_iUnion_old
statement:
theorem compRect_eq_iUnion_old {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h j c v : ℕ) :
    compRect b h j c v = ⋃ ℓ : Fin b, cell b h j c (b * v + ℓ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold compRect cell
  
  rw [vcell_succ_eq_iUnion hb h j v, Set.prod_iUnion]

name: R56Audit.compRect_eq_iUnion_new
statement:
theorem compRect_eq_iUnion_new {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h j c v : ℕ) :
    compRect b h j c v = ⋃ k : Fin b, cell b h (j + 1) (b * c + k) v
proof:
:= by
  unfold compRect cell
  
  rw [hcell_eq_iUnion_children hb j c, Set.iUnion_prod_const]

name: R56Audit.volume_compRect
statement:
theorem volume_compRect {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hj : j < h) (c v : ℕ) :
    volume (compRect b h j c v) = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1))
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [compRect, Measure.volume_eq_prod, Measure.prod_prod, volume_hcell hb, volume_vcell hb,
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
  congr 1
  
  rw [pow_eq_mul_pow_pred (by omega : 0 < h), pow_succ]
  field_simp

name: R56Audit.bottomStrip_eq_cell
statement: theorem bottomStrip_eq_cell (b h j c v : ℕ) : bottomStrip b h j c v = cell b h j c (b * v)
proof:
:=
  bottomStrip_eq b h j c v

name: R56Audit.topStrip_eq_cell
statement:
theorem topStrip_eq_cell {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h j c v : ℕ) :
    topStrip b h j c v = cell b h j c (b * v + (b - 1))
proof:
:=
  topStrip_eq hb h j c v

name: R56Audit.Ico_sdiff_bottom_top_block
statement:
lemma Ico_sdiff_bottom_top_block (s : ℝ) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    Set.Ico s (s + b * L) \ (block s L 0 ∪ block s L (b - 1)) =
      Set.Ico (s + L) (s + ((b : ℝ) - 1) * L)
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  simp only [block, Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_Ico, not_or, not_and, not_lt,
    Nat.cast_pred hb, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add, one_mul, sub_add_cancel]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩
    exact ⟨h3 h1, lt_of_not_ge fun hy => (h4 hy).not_gt h2⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, fun _ => h1, fun hy => absurd h2 hy.not_gt⟩

name: R56Audit.innerRegion_eq_diff
statement:
theorem innerRegion_eq_diff {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h j c v : ℕ) :
    innerRegion b h j c v =
      compRect b h j c v \ (cell b h j c (b * v) ∪ cell b h j c (b * v + (b - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  
  have hB1 : vcell b h j (b * v) = block ((v : ℝ) * vlen b h (j + 1)) (vlen b h j) 0 :=
    vcell_eq_block b h j v 0
  
  rw [compRect, cell, cell, ← Set.prod_union, Set.prod_sdiff_prod, Set.sdiff_self,
    Set.empty_prod, Set.union_empty, vcell_succ_eq, hB1, vcell_eq_block,
    Ico_sdiff_bottom_top_block _ (vlen_pos hb h j).le hb]
  
  unfold innerRegion hcell vlen
  congr 2 <;> ring

name: R56Audit.innerRegion_eq_iUnion
statement:
theorem innerRegion_eq_iUnion {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (h j c v : ℕ) :
    innerRegion b h j c v = ⋃ ℓ ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (b - 1), cell b h j c (b * v + ℓ)
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by omega
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · 
    intro z hz
    rw [innerRegion_eq_diff hb0, compRect_eq_iUnion_old hb0] at hz
    obtain ⟨hz1, hz2⟩ := hz
    obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz1
    have hlt := ℓ.isLt
    have h0 : (ℓ : ℕ) ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hz2 (Or.inl (by rwa [h0, add_zero] at hℓ))
    have h1 : (ℓ : ℕ) ≠ b - 1 := fun h1 => hz2 (Or.inr (by rwa [h1] at hℓ))
    exact Set.mem_biUnion (Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩) hℓ
  · 
    refine Set.iUnion₂_subset fun ℓ hℓ => ?_
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Finset.mem_Ico.mp hℓ
    exact prod_vcell_subset_innerRegion hb0 h j c v h1 (by omega)

name: R56Audit.Zpot_eq_sum_cells
statement:
theorem Zpot_eq_sum_cells (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) (b h j : ℕ) (P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ) :
    Zpot χ b h j P = (∑ c : Fin (b ^ j), ∑ v : Fin (b ^ (h - j)),
      osc (vcell b h j v) (endAvg χ P (((c : ℕ) : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ j)
        ((((c : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) / (b : ℝ) ^ j))) / (b : ℝ) ^ h
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: R56Audit.figure_1_cells

name: R56Audit.figure_1_shaded
statement:
theorem figure_1_shaded :

name: R56Audit.figure_1_compRects
statement: theorem figure_1_compRects : Fintype.card (Fin (4 ^ 0) × Fin (4 ^ (2 - 0 - 1))) = 4

name: R56Audit.finAvg_update
statement:
lemma finAvg_update [Nonempty D] (i : Fin n) (F : (Fin n → D) → ℝ) :
    finAvg (fun r => finAvg (fun d => F (Function.update r i d))) = finAvg F
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := finAvg_prod (fun p : (Fin n → D) × D => F (Function.update p.1 i p.2))
  have h2 := finAvg_equiv (updateEquiv i) (fun p : (Fin n → D) × D => F p.1)
  have h3 := finAvg_prod (fun p : (Fin n → D) × D => F p.1)
  have h4 : finAvg (fun r : Fin n → D => finAvg (fun _ : D => F r)) = finAvg F :=
    finAvg_congr fun r => finAvg_const _
  rw [← h1]
  exact h2.trans (h3.trans h4)

name: R56Audit.finAvg_mul_coord
statement:
lemma finAvg_mul_coord [Nonempty D] (i : Fin n) (g : D → ℝ) (Y : (Fin n → D) → ℝ)
    (hY : ∀ r d, Y (Function.update r i d) = Y r) :
    finAvg (fun r => g (r i) * Y r) = finAvg g * finAvg Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← finAvg_update i]
  simp only [Function.update_self, hY]
  simp_rw [finAvg_mul_const]
  rw [finAvg_const_mul]

name: R56Audit.finAvg_coord
statement:
lemma finAvg_coord [Nonempty D] (i : Fin n) (g : D → ℝ) :
    finAvg (fun r : Fin n → D => g (r i)) = finAvg g
proof:
:= by
  have h := finAvg_mul_coord i g (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (fun _ _ => rfl)
  simpa using h

name: R56Audit.finAvg_neg'
statement:
lemma finAvg_neg' {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (f : α → ℝ) :
    finAvg (fun x => -f x) = -finAvg f
proof:
:= by
  have := finAvg_const_mul (-1) f
  simpa using this

name: R56Audit.finAvg_eq_zero_of_symm
statement:
lemma finAvg_eq_zero_of_symm (φ : D ≃ D) (g : D → ℝ) (h : ∀ d, g (φ d) = -g d) :
    finAvg g = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := finAvg_equiv φ g
  simp only [h] at h1
  rw [finAvg_neg'] at h1
  linarith

name: R56Audit.exists_symm_perm_iff
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ, hφ⟩ v
    apply Nat.card_congr
    exact
      { toFun := fun d => ⟨φ d.1, by rw [hφ, d.2]⟩
        invFun := fun d => ⟨φ.symm d.1, by
          have h := hφ (φ.symm d.1)
          rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, d.2] at h
          linarith⟩
        left_inv := fun d => by simp
        right_inv := fun d => by simp }
  · intro h
    have e : ∀ v : ℝ, {d // x d = v} ≃ {d // x d = -v} := fun v =>
      (Finite.card_eq.mp (h v)).some
    let φ : D → D := fun d => (e (x d) ⟨d, rfl⟩).1
    have hφ : ∀ d, x (φ d) = -x d := fun d => (e (x d) ⟨d, rfl⟩).2
    have hval : ∀ d (v : ℝ) (hv : x d = v), φ d = (e v ⟨d, hv⟩).1 := by
      intro d v hv
      subst hv
      rfl
    have hinj : Function.Injective φ := by
      intro d d' hdd
      have hx : x d = x d' := by
        have h1 := hφ d
        have h2 := hφ d'
        rw [hdd] at h1
        linarith
      rw [hval d (x d') hx, hval d' (x d') rfl] at hdd
      have := (e (x d')).injective (Subtype.ext hdd)
      exact congrArg Subtype.val this
    exact ⟨Equiv.ofBijective φ (Finite.injective_iff_bijective.mp hinj), hφ⟩

name: R56Audit.splitDigits_symm_mem
statement:
lemma splitDigits_symm_mem (S : Finset (Fin n)) (p : ({i // i ∈ S} → D) × ({i // i ∉ S} → D))
    (i : {i // i ∈ S}) : (splitDigits S D).symm p i = p.1 i
proof:
:= by
  simp [splitDigits, Equiv.piEquivPiSubtypeProd, i.2]

name: R56Audit.splitDigits_symm_notMem
statement:
lemma splitDigits_symm_notMem (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (p : ({i // i ∈ S} → D) × ({i // i ∉ S} → D)) {i : Fin n} (hi : i ∉ S) :
    (splitDigits S D).symm p i = p.2 ⟨i, hi⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [splitDigits, Equiv.piEquivPiSubtypeProd, hi]

name: R56Audit.symmetric_sum_abs
statement:
theorem symmetric_sum_abs [Nonempty D] (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x : Fin n → D → ℝ)
    (φ : Fin n → D ≃ D) (hφ : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ d, x i (φ i d) = -x i d) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (h2 : ∀ i ∈ S, finAvg (fun d => x i d ^ 2) = σ ^ 2)
    (h4 : ∀ i ∈ S, finAvg (fun d => x i d ^ 4) ≤ 3 * σ ^ 4)
    (θ : (Fin n → D) → ℝ)
    (hθ : ∀ r r' : Fin n → D, (∀ i, i ∉ S → r i = r' i) → θ r = θ r') :
    σ * Real.sqrt (S.card / 3) ≤ finAvg (fun r : Fin n → D => |θ r + jumpSum S x r|)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases hσ.eq_or_lt with rfl | hσpos
  · rw [zero_mul]
    exact finAvg_nonneg fun _ => abs_nonneg _
  
  rw [← finAvg_equiv (splitDigits S D).symm, finAvg_prod, finAvg_finAvg_comm]
  have hne : Nonempty ({i // i ∉ S} → D) := ⟨fun _ => Classical.arbitrary D⟩
  refine le_trans (le_of_eq (finAvg_const (α := {i // i ∉ S} → D) _).symm) (finAvg_mono fun rO => ?_)
  
  have hconst : ∀ rS : {i // i ∈ S} → D,
      θ ((splitDigits S D).symm (rS, rO)) =
        θ ((splitDigits S D).symm (fun _ => Classical.arbitrary D, rO)) := fun rS =>
    hθ _ _ fun i hi => by rw [splitDigits_symm_notMem S _ hi, splitDigits_symm_notMem S _ hi]
  have hsum : ∀ rS : {i // i ∈ S} → D,
      jumpSum S x ((splitDigits S D).symm (rS, rO)) = ∑ i : {i // i ∈ S}, x i (rS i) := by
    intro rS
    unfold jumpSum
    rw [← Finset.sum_coe_sort S (fun i => x i ((splitDigits S D).symm (rS, rO) i))]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [splitDigits_symm_mem]
  
  have hF := fact_2_2_uniform (fun i : {i // i ∈ S} => x i) (fun i : {i // i ∈ S} => φ i)
    (fun i d => hφ i i.2 d) hσpos (fun i => h2 i i.2) (fun i => h4 i i.2)
    (θ ((splitDigits S D).symm (fun _ => Classical.arbitrary D, rO)))
  rw [Fintype.card_coe] at hF
  refine hF.trans (le_of_eq (finAvg_congr fun rS => ?_))
  rw [hconst rS, hsum rS]

name: R56Audit.fact_2_2
statement:
theorem fact_2_2 [Nonempty D] {m : ℕ} (x : Fin m → D → ℝ) (φ : Fin m → D ≃ D)
    (hφ : ∀ i d, x i (φ i d) = -x i d) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (h2 : ∀ i, finAvg (fun d => x i d ^ 2) = σ ^ 2)
    (h4 : ∀ i, finAvg (fun d => x i d ^ 4) ≤ 3 * σ ^ 4) (θ : ℝ) :
    σ * Real.sqrt (m / 3) ≤ finAvg (fun r : Fin m → D => |θ + ∑ i, x i (r i)|)
proof:
:= by
  have h := fact_2_2_uniform x φ hφ hσ h2 h4 θ
  rwa [Fintype.card_fin] at h

name: R56Audit.mem_innerRegion_iff_Ioc
statement:
theorem mem_innerRegion_iff_Ioc (b h j c v : ℕ) (z : ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : z.1 ≠ (c : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ j)
    (hy1 : z.2 ≠ ((v : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) + (b : ℝ) ^ j) / (b : ℝ) ^ h)
    (hy2 : z.2 ≠ (((v : ℝ) + 1) * (b : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) - (b : ℝ) ^ j) / (b : ℝ) ^ h) :
    z ∈ innerRegion b h j c v ↔ z ∈ innerRegionIoc b h j c v
proof:
:= by
  unfold innerRegion innerRegionIoc
  simp only [Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_Icc, Set.mem_Ico, Set.mem_Ioc]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩
    exact ⟨⟨lt_of_le_of_ne h1 (Ne.symm hx), h2⟩, lt_of_le_of_ne h3 (Ne.symm hy1), h4.le⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩
    exact ⟨⟨h1.le, h2⟩, h3.le, lt_of_le_of_ne h4 hy2⟩

name: R56Audit.mem_innerRegion_iff_of_noGrid
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_innerRegion_iff_Ioc b h j c v (P i) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · have := (hP i (c : ℤ) j).1
    push_cast at this
    exact this
  · have := (hP i ((v : ℤ) * (b : ℤ) ^ (j + 1) + (b : ℤ) ^ j) h).2
    push_cast at this
    exact this
  · have := (hP i (((v : ℤ) + 1) * (b : ℤ) ^ (j + 1) - (b : ℤ) ^ j) h).2
    push_cast at this
    exact this

name: R56Audit.mem_innerRegionIoc_iff
statement:
lemma mem_innerRegionIoc_iff {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (c v : ℕ) (z : ℝ × ℝ) :
    z ∈ innerRegionIoc b h j c v ↔
      z.1 ∈ Set.Ioc ((c : ℝ) / (b ^ j : ℕ)) (((c + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (b ^ j : ℕ)) ∧
      z.2 ∈ Set.Ioc (((v * (b * b ^ j) + b ^ j : ℕ) : ℝ) / (b ^ h : ℕ))
        (((v * (b * b ^ j) + (b - 1) * b ^ j : ℕ) : ℝ) / (b ^ h : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : (((v * (b * b ^ j) + b ^ j : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
      (v : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) + (b : ℝ) ^ j := by
    push_cast; ring
  have e2 : (((v * (b * b ^ j) + (b - 1) * b ^ j : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
      ((v : ℝ) + 1) * (b : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) - (b : ℝ) ^ j := by
    push_cast [Nat.cast_sub hb]; ring
  unfold innerRegionIoc
  rw [Set.mem_prod, e1, e2]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: R56Audit.rectangularBucket_eq_some_iff
statement:
theorem rectangularBucket_eq_some_iff {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hj : j < h)
    (c : Fin (b ^ j)) (v : Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1))) (z : ℝ × ℝ)
    (hz1 : z.1 ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hz2 : z.2 ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    rectangularBucket (b ^ j) (b ^ (h - j - 1)) b (b ^ j) (pow_pos (by omega) j)
        (pow_pos (by omega) _) (by omega) (pow_pos (by omega) j) z =
        some (finProdFinEquiv (c, v)) ↔
      z ∈ innerRegionIoc b h j c v
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by omega
  have hK : 0 < b ^ j := pow_pos hb0 j
  have hNpos : 0 < b ^ (h - j - 1) * (b * b ^ j) := by positivity
  have hN : b ^ (h - j - 1) * (b * b ^ j) = b ^ h := layer_fine_size hj
  rw [rectangularBucket_some_iff, mem_innerRegionIoc_iff (by omega)]
  have h1 := fun s => finiteGridIndex_lt_iff hK hz1 s
  have h2 := fun s => finiteGridIndex_lt_iff hNpos hz2 s
  simp only [Set.mem_Ioc, ← hN]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hc, hlo, hhi⟩
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · by_contra hcon
      have := (h1 c).mpr (not_lt.mp hcon)
      omega
    · exact (h1 (c + 1)).mp (by omega)
    · by_contra hcon
      have := (h2 (v * (b * b ^ j) + b ^ j)).mpr (not_lt.mp hcon)
      omega
    · exact (h2 _).mp hhi
  · rintro ⟨⟨ha, hb'⟩, ⟨hlo, hhi⟩⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hlt := (h1 (c + 1)).mpr hb'
      have hge : ¬ (finiteGridIndex (b ^ j) hK z.1).val < c := fun hlt' =>
        absurd ((h1 c).mp hlt') (not_le.mpr ha)
      omega
    · by_contra hcon
      exact absurd ((h2 _).mp (not_le.mp hcon)) (not_le.mpr hlo)
    · exact (h2 _).mpr hhi

name: R56Audit.mem_paperGoodTransition_iff
statement:
theorem mem_paperGoodTransition_iff {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hj : j < h)
    (P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ) (hP : InUnit P) (hgrid : NoGrid b P) :
    P ∈ paperGoodTransition b h (by omega) j ↔ GoodTransition b h j P
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by omega
  let cell : ℝ × ℝ → Option (Fin (b ^ j * b ^ (h - j - 1))) :=
    rectangularBucket (b ^ j) (b ^ (h - j - 1)) b (b ^ j) (pow_pos hb0 j) (pow_pos hb0 _) hb0
      (pow_pos hb0 j)
  let x : Fin n → Option (Fin (b ^ j * b ^ (h - j - 1))) := fun i => cell (P i)
  have hkey : ∀ i (c : Fin (b ^ j)) (v : Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1))),
      x i = some (finProdFinEquiv (c, v)) ↔ P i ∈ innerRegion b h j c v :=
    fun i c v => (rectangularBucket_eq_some_iff hb hj c v (P i) (hP i).1 (hP i).2).trans
      (mem_innerRegion_iff_of_noGrid h j c v hgrid i).symm
  have hcount : ∀ (c : Fin (b ^ j)) (v : Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1))),
      count x (finProdFinEquiv (c, v)) = innerCount b h j P c v := by
    intro c v
    unfold count innerCount
    congr 1
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact hkey i c v
  have hM : (((b ^ j * b ^ (h - j - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)) = (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) := by
    rw [layer_comparison_size hj]
    push_cast
    rfl
  have hheavy : ∀ (c : Fin (b ^ j)) (v : Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1))),
      finProdFinEquiv (c, v) ∈ heavy (b : ℝ) x ↔ Heavy b h j P c v := by
    intro c v
    unfold heavy Heavy
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    rw [hcount c v, hM]
  have hexc : ∀ i, x i ∉ exceptional (heavy (b : ℝ) x) ↔
      ∃ c : Fin (b ^ j), ∃ v : Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)),
        P i ∈ innerRegion b h j c v ∧ ¬ Heavy b h j P c v := by
    intro i
    constructor
    · intro hnot
      cases hx : x i with
      | none => exact absurd (by simp [exceptional, hx]) hnot
      | some a =>
        obtain ⟨⟨c, v⟩, rfl⟩ := finProdFinEquiv.surjective a
        refine ⟨c, v, (hkey i c v).mp hx, fun hh => hnot ?_⟩
        simp only [exceptional, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hx]
        exact Or.inr ⟨_, (hheavy c v).mpr hh, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨c, v, hin, hnh⟩ hmem
      have hx := (hkey i c v).mpr hin
      simp only [exceptional, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hx] at hmem
      rcases hmem with h0 | ⟨a, ha, hsome⟩
      · exact absurd h0 (by simp)
      · have : a = finProdFinEquiv (c, v) := (Option.some.inj hsome).symm
        rw [this] at ha
        exact hnh ((hheavy c v).mp ha)
  
  have hsplit := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)))
    (fun i => x i ∈ exceptional (heavy (b : ℝ) x))
  simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hsplit
  have hgoodset : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ∃ c : Fin (b ^ j), ∃ v : Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)),
      P i ∈ innerRegion b h j c v ∧ ¬ Heavy b h j P c v)) =
      Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ¬ x i ∈ exceptional (heavy (b : ℝ) x)) := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact (hexc i).symm
  change bucketGood (b : ℝ) x ↔ _
  unfold bucketGood GoodTransition
  rw [hgoodset]
  have hsplitR : ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => x i ∈ exceptional (heavy (b : ℝ) x))).card : ℝ) +
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ¬ x i ∈ exceptional (heavy (b : ℝ) x))).card = n := by
    exact_mod_cast hsplit
  constructor
  · intro hg
    have hgR : (2 : ℝ) * (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => x i ∈ exceptional (heavy (b : ℝ) x))).card ≤
        n := by exact_mod_cast hg
    linarith
  · intro hg
    have : (2 : ℝ) * (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => x i ∈ exceptional (heavy (b : ℝ) x))).card ≤
        n := by linarith
    exact_mod_cast this

name: R56Audit.lemma_2_5_ii_archive
statement:
theorem lemma_2_5_ii_archive {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 3 ≤ b) (hMn : b ^ (h - 1) ≤ n) (hj : j < h) :
    (unifPts n).real {P | ¬ GoodTransition b h j P} ≤ (48 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 0 < n := lt_of_lt_of_le (pow_pos (by omega) _) hMn
  refine le_trans ?_ (R65.bad_transition_bound hn hb hMn hj)
  have hgrid := ae_noGrid n b
  rw [← pointSampleLaw_eq_unifPts] at hgrid ⊢
  apply ENNReal.toReal_mono (measure_ne_top _ _)
  apply measure_mono_ae
  filter_upwards [ae_pointSampleLaw_mem_Ioc n, hgrid] with P hP hPg
  intro hbad hgood
  exact hbad ((mem_paperGoodTransition_iff (by omega) hj P hP hPg).mp hgood)

name: R56Audit.lemma_2_5_ii_all_archive
statement:
theorem lemma_2_5_ii_all_archive {b h : ℕ} (hb : 3 ≤ b) (hMn : b ^ (h - 1) ≤ n) :
    (unifPts n).real {P | ∃ j, j < h ∧ ¬ GoodTransition b h j P} ≤
      h * (48 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 0 < n := lt_of_lt_of_le (pow_pos (by omega) _) hMn
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos h with rfl | hh
  · have : {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ | ∃ j, j < 0 ∧ ¬ GoodTransition b 0 j P} = ∅ := by
      ext P; simp
    rw [this]
    simp
  refine le_trans ?_ (R65.all_good_compl_bound hn hb hh hMn)
  have hgrid := ae_noGrid n b
  rw [← pointSampleLaw_eq_unifPts] at hgrid ⊢
  apply ENNReal.toReal_mono (measure_ne_top _ _)
  apply measure_mono_ae
  filter_upwards [ae_pointSampleLaw_mem_Ioc n, hgrid] with P hP hPg
  rintro ⟨j, hj, hbad⟩ hall
  exact hbad ((mem_paperGoodTransition_iff (by omega) hj P hP hPg).mp (hall j hj))

name: R56Audit.innerRegion_one_zero
statement: lemma innerRegion_one_zero {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) : innerRegion b 1 0 0 0 = unitInnerRegion b
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (b : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hb.ne'
  
  have htop : ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (b : ℝ) = 1 - 1 / (b : ℝ) := by rw [sub_div, div_self hbR]
  unfold innerRegion unitInnerRegion
  
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, zero_mul, one_mul, pow_zero, pow_one, div_one]
  rw [htop]

name: R56Audit.sum_fin_of_eq_one
statement: lemma sum_fin_of_eq_one {k : ℕ} (hk : k = 1) (f : ℕ → ℝ) : ∑ c : Fin k, f c = f 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range f k, hk, Finset.sum_range_one]

name: R56Audit.delta_one_zero
statement:
lemma delta_one_zero {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ) :
    delta b 1 0 P = Real.sqrt (unitInnerCount b P) / (4 * (b : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  
  have hcount : innerCount b 1 0 P 0 0 = unitInnerCount b P := by
    unfold innerCount unitInnerCount
    rw [innerRegion_one_zero hb]
  
  have hsum : ∑ c : Fin (b ^ 0), ∑ v : Fin (b ^ (1 - 0 - 1)), Real.sqrt (innerCount b 1 0 P c v) =
      Real.sqrt (unitInnerCount b P) := by
    rw [sum_fin_of_eq_one (pow_zero b)
        (fun c => ∑ v : Fin (b ^ (1 - 0 - 1)), Real.sqrt (innerCount b 1 0 P c v)),
      sum_fin_of_eq_one (pow_zero b : b ^ (1 - 0 - 1) = 1)
        (fun v => Real.sqrt (innerCount b 1 0 P 0 v)), hcount]
  
  unfold delta
  rw [hsum, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, mul_one]

name: R56Audit.coarseInfo_pow_zero
statement:
lemma coarseInfo_pow_zero (b : ℕ) {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ} (hP : InUnit P) :
    coarseInfo n (b ^ 0) P = (fun i => (P i).2, fun _ => 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine Prod.ext rfl (funext fun i => ?_)
  
  obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := gridIndex_bounds 1 one_pos (hP i).1
  have h0' : (0 : ℤ) ≤ gridIndex 1 (P i).1 := by exact_mod_cast h0
  have h1' : gridIndex 1 (P i).1 + 1 ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast h1
  change gridIndex (b ^ 0) (P i).1 = 0
  rw [pow_zero]
  omega

name: R56Audit.condExp_heightSigma
statement:
theorem condExp_heightSigma (b : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ) :
    (unifPts n)[f | heightSigma n] =ᵐ[unifPts n] (unifPts n)[f | stageSigma n b 0]
proof:
:= by
  have hheights : Measurable (fun (P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ) (i : Fin n) => (P i).2) :=
    measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun i => measurable_snd.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  
  refine condExp_comap_congr_ae (e := fun V => (V, fun _ => 0)) (e' := Prod.fst) hheights
    (measurable_coarseInfo n (b ^ 0)) (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const) measurable_fst
    ?_ ?_ f
  · filter_upwards [ae_inUnit n] with P hP
    exact coarseInfo_pow_zero b hP
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun P => rfl

name: R56Audit.integrable_supNorm
statement: lemma integrable_supNorm (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) : Integrable (supNorm χ) (unifPts n)
proof:
:= by
  refine Integrable.of_bound (measurable_supNorm χ).aestronglyMeasurable n
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun P => ?_)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (supNorm_nonneg χ P), supNorm_le_iff]
  exact fun x _ y _ => abs_F_le χ P x y

name: R56Audit.one_rectangle
statement:
theorem one_rectangle {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) :
    ∀ᵐ P ∂unifPts n, Real.sqrt (unitInnerCount b P) / (8 * (b : ℝ)) ≤
      ((unifPts n)[supNorm χ | heightSigma n]) P
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by omega
  
  have hgain : ∀ᵐ P ∂unifPts n, delta b 1 0 P ≤
      ((unifPts n)[fun P => Zpot χ b 1 1 P - Zpot χ b 1 0 P | stageSigma n b 0]) P :=
    lemma_2_4 (h := 1) (j := 0) hb one_pos χ
  
  have hZ : ∀ j ≤ 1, Integrable (Zpot χ b 1 j) (unifPts n) := fun j hj => by
    rw [← pointSampleLaw_eq_unifPts]
    exact integrable_Zpot hb0 hj χ
  have hle : (fun P => Zpot χ b 1 1 P - Zpot χ b 1 0 P) ≤ᵐ[unifPts n] (2 : ℝ) • supNorm χ :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun P => by
      have h1 : Zpot χ b 1 1 P ≤ 2 * supNorm χ P := Zpot_le_two_supNorm hb0 le_rfl χ P
      have h0 : 0 ≤ Zpot χ b 1 0 P := Zpot_nonneg hb0 χ 1 0 P
      change Zpot χ b 1 1 P - Zpot χ b 1 0 P ≤ 2 * supNorm χ P
      linarith
  have hmono : (unifPts n)[fun P => Zpot χ b 1 1 P - Zpot χ b 1 0 P | stageSigma n b 0]
      ≤ᵐ[unifPts n] (unifPts n)[(2 : ℝ) • supNorm χ | stageSigma n b 0] :=
    condExp_mono ((hZ 1 le_rfl).sub (hZ 0 zero_le_one)) ((integrable_supNorm χ).smul (2 : ℝ)) hle
  have hsmul := condExp_smul (μ := unifPts n) (2 : ℝ) (supNorm χ) (stageSigma n b 0)
  
  filter_upwards [hgain, hmono, hsmul, condExp_heightSigma b (supNorm χ)] with P h1 h2 h3 h4
  
  rw [delta_one_zero hb0] at h1
  rw [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← h4] at h3
  
  have hhalf : Real.sqrt (unitInnerCount b P) / (8 * (b : ℝ)) =
      Real.sqrt (unitInnerCount b P) / (4 * (b : ℝ)) / 2 := by ring
  linarith

name: R56Audit.abs_F_le
statement: lemma abs_F_le (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) (P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ) (x y : ℝ) : |F χ P x y| ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold F
  calc |∑ i, (if P i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ × ℝ) (x, y) then (((χ i : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ) else 0)|
      ≤ ∑ i, |(if P i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ × ℝ) (x, y) then (((χ i : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ) else 0)| :=
        Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin n, (1 : ℝ) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
        split_ifs
        · rcases Int.units_eq_one_or (χ i) with h | h <;> simp [h]
        · simp
    _ = n := by simp

name: R56Audit.bddAbove_F
statement:
lemma bddAbove_F (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) (P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ) :
    BddAbove (Set.range fun z : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 × Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 => |F χ P z.1 z.2|)
proof:
:=
  ⟨n, by rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩; exact abs_F_le χ P _ _⟩

name: R56Audit.le_supNorm
proof:
:=
  le_ciSup (f := fun z : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 × Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 => |F χ P z.1 z.2|)
    (bddAbove_F χ P) (⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨y, hy⟩)

name: R56Audit.supNorm_le_iff
statement:
lemma supNorm_le_iff (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) (P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ) (B : ℝ) :
    supNorm χ P ≤ B ↔
      ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, |F χ P x y| ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 × Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
    ⟨(⟨0, by simp⟩, ⟨0, by simp⟩)⟩
  unfold supNorm
  rw [ciSup_le_iff (bddAbove_F χ P)]
  constructor
  · intro h x hx y hy
    exact h (⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨y, hy⟩)
  · intro h z
    exact h z.1 z.1.2 z.2 z.2.2

name: R56Audit.supNorm_nonneg
statement: lemma supNorm_nonneg (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) (P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ) : 0 ≤ supNorm χ P
proof:
:=
  (abs_nonneg _).trans (le_supNorm χ P (x := 0) (y := 0) (by simp) (by simp))

name: R56Audit.F_eq_filter
statement:
lemma F_eq_filter (χ : Fin n → ℤˣ) (P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ) (x y : ℝ) :
    F χ P x y = ∑ t ∈ Finset.univ.filter
      (fun t => 0 ≤ (P t).1 ∧ (P t).1 ≤ x ∧ 0 ≤ (P t).2 ∧ (P t).2 ≤ y),
        (((χ t : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold F
  rw [Finset.sum_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ => ?_
  have h : P t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ × ℝ) (x, y) ↔
      (0 ≤ (P t).1 ∧ (P t).1 ≤ x ∧ 0 ≤ (P t).2 ∧ (P t).2 ≤ y) := by
    simp only [Set.mem_Icc, Prod.le_def, Prod.fst_zero, Prod.snd_zero]
    tauto
  by_cases hq : P t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ × ℝ) (x, y)
  · rw [ite_eq_left hq, ite_eq_left (h.mp hq)]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hq, ite_eq_right (fun h' => hq (h.mpr h'))]

name: R56Audit.stepFn_add
statement:
lemma stepFn_add (V c c' : Fin n → ℝ) (y : ℝ) :
    stepFn V (fun i => c i + c' i) y = stepFn V c y + stepFn V c' y
proof:
:= by
  unfold stepFn
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by split_ifs <;> simp

name: R56Audit.stepFn_sum
statement:
lemma stepFn_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (V : Fin n → ℝ) (c : ι → Fin n → ℝ) (y : ℝ) :
    stepFn V (fun i => ∑ k ∈ s, c k i) y = ∑ k ∈ s, stepFn V (c k) y
proof:
:= by
  unfold stepFn
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by split_ifs <;> simp

name: R56Audit.stepFn_div
statement:
lemma stepFn_div (V c : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (y : ℝ) :
    stepFn V (fun i => c i / t) y = stepFn V c y / t
proof:
:= by
  unfold stepFn
  rw [Finset.sum_div]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by split_ifs <;> simp

name: R56Audit.stepFn_congr
statement:
lemma stepFn_congr (V : Fin n → ℝ) {c c' : Fin n → ℝ} (h : ∀ i, c i = c' i) (y : ℝ) :
    stepFn V c y = stepFn V c' y
proof:
:= by
  unfold stepFn
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [h i]

name: R56Audit.stepFn_image_finite
statement: lemma stepFn_image_finite (V c : Fin n → ℝ) (B : Set ℝ) : ((stepFn V c) '' B).Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine (Set.finite_range (fun T : Finset (Fin n) => ∑ i ∈ T, c i)).subset ?_
  rintro _ ⟨y, -, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨Finset.univ.filter (fun i => V i ≤ y), ?_⟩
  simp only [stepFn]
  rw [Finset.sum_filter]

name: R56Audit.stepFn_eq_zero
statement:
lemma stepFn_eq_zero (V : Fin n → ℝ) {c : Fin n → ℝ} {y : ℝ} (h : ∀ i, c i ≠ 0 → y < V i) :
    stepFn V c y = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold stepFn
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
  split_ifs with hi
  · by_contra hc
    exact absurd hi (not_le.mpr (h i hc))
  · rfl

name: R56Audit.stepFn_eq_sum
statement:
lemma stepFn_eq_sum (V : Fin n → ℝ) {c : Fin n → ℝ} {y : ℝ} (h : ∀ i, c i ≠ 0 → V i ≤ y) :
    stepFn V c y = ∑ i, c i
proof:
:= by
  unfold stepFn
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  split_ifs with hi
  · rfl
  · by_contra hc
    exact hi (h i (fun h0 => hc (by rw [h0])))

name: R56Audit.finAvg_stepFn
statement:
lemma finAvg_stepFn {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [Nonempty α] (V : Fin n → ℝ) (c : α → Fin n → ℝ)
    (y : ℝ) :
    finAvg (fun r => stepFn V (c r) y) = stepFn V (fun i => finAvg (fun r => c r i)) y
proof:
:= by
  unfold stepFn
  rw [finAvg_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  split_ifs
  · rfl
  · exact finAvg_const 0

name: R56Audit.stepFn_ite
statement:
lemma stepFn_ite (V x : Fin n → ℝ) (p : Fin n → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (y : ℝ) :
    stepFn V (fun i => if p i then x i else 0) y =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => p i ∧ V i ≤ y), x i
proof:
:= by
  unfold stepFn
  rw [Finset.sum_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  by_cases h1 : V i ≤ y <;> by_cases h2 : p i <;> simp [h1, h2]

name: R56Audit.childAvg_congr
proof:
:= by
  funext y
  refine stepFn_congr V (fun i => ?_) y
  cases hs : side i with
  | left => simp [childWeight]
  | right => simp [childWeight]
  | inside => rw [h i hs]

name: R56Audit.mem_innerPoints_iff
statement:
theorem mem_innerPoints_iff {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side) (s : ℝ)
    {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (i : Fin n) :
    i ∈ innerPoints b V side s L ↔
      side i = Side.inside ∧ V i ∈ ⋃ ℓ ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (b - 1), block s L ℓ
proof:
:= by
  rw [iUnion_inner_blocks s hL hb]
  simp [innerPoints]

name: R56Audit.childMean_image_finite
statement:
lemma childMean_image_finite {b : ℕ} (ε V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side)
    (r : Fin n → Fin b) (A : Set ℝ) : ((childMean ε V side r) '' A).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have h : childMean ε V side r =
      stepFn V (fun i => (∑ k : Fin b, ε i * childWeight (side i) (r i) k) / b) := by
    funext y
    unfold childMean childAvg
    rw [stepFn_div, stepFn_sum]
  rw [h]
  exact stepFn_image_finite V _ A

name: R56Audit.avg_comparison_core
statement:
theorem avg_comparison_core {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (ε V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side)
    (J : Set ℝ) (B : Fin b → Set ℝ) (hne : ∀ ℓ, (B ℓ).Nonempty) (hsub : ∀ ℓ, B ℓ ⊆ J)
    (hcomp : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, (f '' J).Finite →
      ∑ ℓ : Fin b, osc (B ℓ) f +
          2 * |mid (B ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩) f - mid (B ⟨0, by omega⟩) f| ≤ b * osc J f)
    (r : Fin n → Fin b) :
    ∑ ℓ : Fin b, osc (B ℓ) (childMean ε V side r) +
        2 * |mid (B ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩) (childMean ε V side r) -
          mid (B ⟨0, by omega⟩) (childMean ε V side r)| ≤
      ∑ k : Fin b, osc J (childAvg ε V side r k)
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by omega
  have : Nonempty (Fin b) := ⟨⟨0, hb0⟩⟩
  have hJ : J.Nonempty := (hne ⟨0, hb0⟩).mono (hsub ⟨0, hb0⟩)
  
  
  have h1 : (b : ℝ) * osc J (childMean ε V side r) ≤
      ∑ k : Fin b, osc J (childAvg ε V side r k) := by
    have h := card_mul_osc_avg_le (ι := Fin b) (B := J)
      (f := fun k => childAvg ε V side r k) hJ (fun k => stepFn_image_finite V _ _)
    rw [Fintype.card_fin] at h
    exact h
  
  exact (hcomp _ (childMean_image_finite ε V side r J)).trans h1

name: R56Audit.display_5
statement:
theorem display_5 {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (ε V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side) (s : ℝ) {L : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (r : Fin n → Fin b) :
    ∑ ℓ : Fin b, osc (block s L ℓ) (childMean ε V side r) +
        2 * |mid (block s L (b - 1)) (childMean ε V side r) -
          mid (block s L 0) (childMean ε V side r)| ≤
      ∑ k : Fin b, osc (Set.Ico s (s + b * L)) (childAvg ε V side r k)
proof:
:=
  avg_comparison_core hb ε V side (Set.Ico s (s + b * L)) (fun ℓ : Fin b => block s L ℓ)
    (fun ℓ => block_nonempty s hL ℓ) (fun ℓ => block_subset s hL ℓ.isLt)
    (fun f hf => vertical_comparison hb s hL f hf) r

name: R56Audit.sum_childWeight
statement:
lemma sum_childWeight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (sd : Side) (r : Fin b) :
    (∑ k : Fin b, childWeight sd r k) / b =
      oldWeight sd + (if sd = Side.inside then ((b : ℝ) - 1 - 2 * (r : ℕ)) / (2 * b) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  cases sd with
  | left =>
    simp only [childWeight, oldWeight, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
      nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, reduceCtorEq, ite_false, add_zero]
    field_simp
  | right =>
    simp [childWeight, oldWeight]
  | inside =>
    simp only [childWeight, oldWeight, ite_true]
    have hsplit : ∀ k : Fin b, (if r < k then (1 : ℝ) else if r = k then 1 / 2 else 0) =
        (if r < k then (1 : ℝ) else 0) + (if r = k then 1 / 2 else 0) := by
      intro k
      by_cases h1 : r < k
      · have h2 : r ≠ k := ne_of_lt h1
        simp [h1, h2]
      · simp [h1]
    simp_rw [hsplit]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq Finset.univ r (fun _ => (1 / 2 : ℝ)),
      ite_eq_left (Finset.mem_univ r), Finset.sum_boole]
    have hcard : (Finset.univ.filter (fun k : Fin b => r < k)).card = b - 1 - r := by
      rw [Finset.filter_lt_eq_Ioi, Fin.card_Ioi]
    rw [hcard]
    have hr : (r : ℕ) + 1 ≤ b := r.isLt
    have hcast : ((b - 1 - (r : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) = (b : ℝ) - 1 - (r : ℕ) := by
      have h : (b - 1 - (r : ℕ)) + (r : ℕ) + 1 = b := by omega
      have h' := congrArg (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℝ) h
      push_cast at h'
      linarith
    rw [hcast]
    field_simp
    ring

name: R56Audit.childMean_eq
statement:
lemma childMean_eq {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (ε V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side)
    (r : Fin n → Fin b) (y : ℝ) :
    childMean ε V side r y =
      stepFn V (fun i => ε i * oldWeight (side i) +
        (if side i = Side.inside then jump b ε i (r i) else 0)) y
proof:
:= by
  unfold childMean childAvg
  rw [← stepFn_sum, ← stepFn_div]
  refine stepFn_congr V (fun i => ?_) y
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, mul_div_assoc, sum_childWeight hb, mul_add]
  unfold jump
  split_ifs <;> ring

name: R56Audit.display_6
statement:
theorem display_6 {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (ε V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side)
    (r : Fin n → Fin b) (y : ℝ) :
    childMean ε V side r y = endpointAvg ε V side y +
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => side i = Side.inside ∧ V i ≤ y), jump b ε i (r i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [childMean_eq hb, stepFn_add, stepFn_ite, endpointAvg]

name: R56Audit.jump_rev
statement:
lemma jump_rev (b : ℕ) (ε : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) (d : Fin b) :
    jump b ε i (Fin.revPerm d) = -jump b ε i d
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (d : ℕ) + 1 ≤ b := d.isLt
  have hcast : (((Fin.rev d : Fin b) : ℕ) : ℝ) = (b : ℝ) - 1 - (d : ℕ) := by
    rw [Fin.val_rev]
    have h : (b - ((d : ℕ) + 1)) + (d : ℕ) + 1 = b := by omega
    have h' := congrArg (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℝ) h
    push_cast at h'
    linarith
  unfold jump
  rw [Fin.revPerm_apply, hcast]
  ring

name: R56Audit.finAvg_jump
statement: lemma finAvg_jump (b : ℕ) (ε : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) : finAvg (jump b ε i) = 0
proof:
:=
  finAvg_eq_zero_of_symm Fin.revPerm (jump b ε i) (jump_rev b ε i)

name: R56Audit.finAvg_childMean
statement:
lemma finAvg_childMean {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (ε V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side) (y : ℝ) :
    finAvg (fun r : Fin n → Fin b => childMean ε V side r y) = endpointAvg ε V side y
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty (Fin b) := ⟨⟨0, hb⟩⟩
  simp_rw [childMean_eq hb]
  rw [finAvg_stepFn]
  unfold endpointAvg
  refine stepFn_congr V (fun i => ?_) y
  rw [finAvg_add, finAvg_const]
  by_cases hs : side i = Side.inside
  · 
    simp only [hs, ite_true]
    rw [finAvg_coord i (jump b ε i), finAvg_jump, add_zero]
  · simp only [hs, ite_false]
    rw [finAvg_const, add_zero]

name: R56Audit.maxOn_endpointAvg_le
statement:
lemma maxOn_endpointAvg_le {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (ε V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side)
    {B : Set ℝ} (hB : B.Nonempty) :
    maxOn B (endpointAvg ε V side) ≤
      finAvg (fun r : Fin n → Fin b => maxOn B (childMean ε V side r))
proof:
:= by
  apply maxOn_le hB
  intro y hy
  rw [← finAvg_childMean hb ε V side y]
  exact finAvg_mono fun r => le_maxOn (childMean_image_finite ε V side r B) hy

name: R56Audit.finAvg_minOn_childMean_le
statement:
lemma finAvg_minOn_childMean_le {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (ε V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side)
    {B : Set ℝ} (hB : B.Nonempty) :
    finAvg (fun r : Fin n → Fin b => minOn B (childMean ε V side r)) ≤
      minOn B (endpointAvg ε V side)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_minOn hB
  intro y hy
  rw [← finAvg_childMean hb ε V side y]
  exact finAvg_mono fun r => minOn_le (childMean_image_finite ε V side r B) hy

name: R56Audit.osc_endpointAvg_le
statement:
lemma osc_endpointAvg_le {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (ε V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side)
    {B : Set ℝ} (hB : B.Nonempty) :
    osc B (endpointAvg ε V side) ≤
      finAvg (fun r : Fin n → Fin b => osc B (childMean ε V side r))
proof:
:= by
  have hmax := maxOn_endpointAvg_le hb ε V side hB
  have hmin := finAvg_minOn_childMean_le hb ε V side hB
  unfold osc
  rw [finAvg_sub]
  linarith

name: R56Audit.expected_comparison_core
statement:
theorem expected_comparison_core {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (ε V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side)
    (J : Set ℝ) (B : Fin b → Set ℝ) (hne : ∀ ℓ, (B ℓ).Nonempty) (hsub : ∀ ℓ, B ℓ ⊆ J)
    (hcomp : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, (f '' J).Finite →
      ∑ ℓ : Fin b, osc (B ℓ) f +
          2 * |mid (B ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩) f - mid (B ⟨0, by omega⟩) f| ≤ b * osc J f) :
    ∑ ℓ : Fin b, osc (B ℓ) (endpointAvg ε V side) +
        2 * finAvg (fun r : Fin n → Fin b =>
          |mid (B ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩) (childMean ε V side r) -
            mid (B ⟨0, by omega⟩) (childMean ε V side r)|) ≤
      finAvg (fun r : Fin n → Fin b => ∑ k : Fin b, osc J (childAvg ε V side r k))
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by omega
  
  have hE := finAvg_mono (avg_comparison_core hb ε V side J B hne hsub hcomp)
  rw [finAvg_add, finAvg_sum, finAvg_const_mul] at hE
  
  have hblocks : ∑ ℓ : Fin b, osc (B ℓ) (endpointAvg ε V side) ≤
      ∑ ℓ : Fin b, finAvg (fun r : Fin n → Fin b => osc (B ℓ) (childMean ε V side r)) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun ℓ _ => osc_endpointAvg_le hb0 ε V side (hne ℓ)
  linarith

name: R56Audit.display_8
statement:
theorem display_8 {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (ε V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side) (s : ℝ) {L : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L) :
    ∑ ℓ : Fin b, osc (block s L ℓ) (endpointAvg ε V side) +
        2 * finAvg (fun r : Fin n → Fin b => |mid (block s L (b - 1)) (childMean ε V side r) -
          mid (block s L 0) (childMean ε V side r)|) ≤
      finAvg (fun r : Fin n → Fin b =>
        ∑ k : Fin b, osc (Set.Ico s (s + b * L)) (childAvg ε V side r k))
proof:
:=
  expected_comparison_core hb ε V side (Set.Ico s (s + b * L)) (fun ℓ : Fin b => block s L ℓ)
    (fun ℓ => block_nonempty s hL ℓ) (fun ℓ => block_subset s hL ℓ.isLt)
    (fun f hf => vertical_comparison hb s hL f hf)

name: R56Audit.withoutJumps_eq
statement:
lemma withoutJumps_eq (b : ℕ) (ε V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side) (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (r : Fin n → Fin b) (y : ℝ) :
    withoutJumps b ε V side S r y = endpointAvg ε V side y +
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => side i = Side.inside ∧ i ∉ S ∧ V i ≤ y),
        jump b ε i (r i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold withoutJumps endpointAvg
  rw [stepFn_add, stepFn_ite]
  congr 1
  exact Finset.sum_congr (Finset.filter_congr fun i _ => and_assoc) fun _ _ => rfl

name: R56Audit.withoutJumps_image_finite
statement:
lemma withoutJumps_image_finite (b : ℕ) (ε V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side)
    (S : Finset (Fin n)) (r : Fin n → Fin b) (A : Set ℝ) :
    ((withoutJumps b ε V side S r) '' A).Finite
proof:
:=
  stepFn_image_finite V _ A

name: R56Audit.innerPoints_between_blocks
statement:
lemma innerPoints_between_blocks {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side)
    (s L : ℝ) :
    ∀ i ∈ innerPoints b V side s L, side i = Side.inside ∧
      (∀ y ∈ block s L 0, y < V i) ∧ (∀ y ∈ block s L (b - 1), V i ≤ y)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  have hi' : side i = Side.inside ∧ s + L ≤ V i ∧ V i < s + ((b : ℝ) - 1) * L := by
    simpa [innerPoints] using hi
  refine ⟨hi'.1, fun y hy => ?_, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  · have h2 : y < s + ((0 : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) * L := hy.2
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, one_mul] at h2
    linarith [hi'.2.1]
  · have h2 : s + ((b - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * L ≤ y := hy.1
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ b), Nat.cast_one] at h2
    linarith [hi'.2.2]

name: R56Audit.childMean_eq_withoutJumps_add
statement:
lemma childMean_eq_withoutJumps_add {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (ε V : Fin n → ℝ)
    (side : Fin n → Side) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (hS : ∀ i ∈ S, side i = Side.inside)
    (r : Fin n → Fin b) (y : ℝ) :
    childMean ε V side r y = withoutJumps b ε V side S r y +
      stepFn V (fun i => if i ∈ S then jump b ε i (r i) else 0) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [childMean_eq hb]
  unfold withoutJumps
  rw [← stepFn_add]
  refine stepFn_congr V (fun i => ?_) y
  by_cases hi : i ∈ S
  · simp [hi, hS i hi]
  · simp [hi]

name: R56Audit.childMean_eq_withoutJumps_of_lt
statement:
lemma childMean_eq_withoutJumps_of_lt {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (ε V : Fin n → ℝ)
    (side : Fin n → Side) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (hS : ∀ i ∈ S, side i = Side.inside)
    (r : Fin n → Fin b) {y : ℝ} (hy : ∀ i ∈ S, y < V i) :
    childMean ε V side r y = withoutJumps b ε V side S r y
proof:
:= by
  rw [childMean_eq_withoutJumps_add hb ε V side S hS, stepFn_eq_zero, add_zero]
  exact fun i hi => hy i (ite_ne_right_iff.mp hi).1

name: R56Audit.childMean_eq_withoutJumps_add_jumpSum_of_le
statement:
lemma childMean_eq_withoutJumps_add_jumpSum_of_le {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (ε V : Fin n → ℝ)
    (side : Fin n → Side) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (hS : ∀ i ∈ S, side i = Side.inside)
    (r : Fin n → Fin b) {y : ℝ} (hy : ∀ i ∈ S, V i ≤ y) :
    childMean ε V side r y = withoutJumps b ε V side S r y + jumpSum S (jump b ε) r
proof:
:= by
  rw [childMean_eq_withoutJumps_add hb ε V side S hS, stepFn_eq_sum]
  · rw [Finset.sum_ite_mem, Finset.univ_inter, jumpSum]
  · exact fun i hi => hy i (ite_ne_right_iff.mp hi).1

name: R56Audit.offset_core
statement:
theorem offset_core {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (ε V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side)
    (B : Fin b → Set ℝ) (hne : ∀ ℓ, (B ℓ).Nonempty) (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (hS : ∀ i ∈ S, side i = Side.inside ∧ (∀ y ∈ B ⟨0, by omega⟩, y < V i) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ B ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩, V i ≤ y))
    (r : Fin n → Fin b) :
    mid (B ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩) (childMean ε V side r) -
        mid (B ⟨0, by omega⟩) (childMean ε V side r) =
      (mid (B ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩) (withoutJumps b ε V side S r) -
        mid (B ⟨0, by omega⟩) (withoutJumps b ε V side S r)) +
      jumpSum S (jump b ε) r
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by omega
  have hI : ∀ i ∈ S, side i = Side.inside := fun i hi => (hS i hi).1
  
  have hbot : ∀ y ∈ B ⟨0, by omega⟩,
      childMean ε V side r y = withoutJumps b ε V side S r y := fun y hy =>
    childMean_eq_withoutJumps_of_lt hb0 ε V side S hI r fun i hi => (hS i hi).2.1 y hy
  have htop : ∀ y ∈ B ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩,
      childMean ε V side r y = withoutJumps b ε V side S r y + jumpSum S (jump b ε) r :=
    fun y hy => childMean_eq_withoutJumps_add_jumpSum_of_le hb0 ε V side S hI r
      fun i hi => (hS i hi).2.2 y hy
  
  rw [mid_congr hbot, mid_congr htop,
    mid_add_const (hne _) (withoutJumps_image_finite b ε V side S r _)]
  ring

name: R56Audit.offset_eq
statement:
theorem offset_eq {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (ε V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side) (s : ℝ) {L : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (r : Fin n → Fin b) :
    mid (block s L (b - 1)) (childMean ε V side r) - mid (block s L 0) (childMean ε V side r) =
      (mid (block s L (b - 1)) (withoutJumps b ε V side (innerPoints b V side s L) r) -
        mid (block s L 0) (withoutJumps b ε V side (innerPoints b V side s L) r)) +
      jumpSum (innerPoints b V side s L) (jump b ε) r
proof:
:=
  offset_core hb ε V side (fun ℓ : Fin b => block s L ℓ) (fun ℓ => block_nonempty s hL ℓ)
    (innerPoints b V side s L) (innerPoints_between_blocks hb V side s L) r

name: R56Audit.withoutJumps_congr
statement:
lemma withoutJumps_congr (b : ℕ) (ε V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side) (S : Finset (Fin n))
    {r r' : Fin n → Fin b} (h : ∀ i, side i = Side.inside → i ∉ S → r i = r' i) :
    withoutJumps b ε V side S r = withoutJumps b ε V side S r'
proof:
:= by
  funext y
  refine stepFn_congr V (fun i => ?_) y
  by_cases hi : side i = Side.inside ∧ i ∉ S
  · rw [h i hi.1 hi.2]
  · simp [hi]

name: R56Audit.sum_range_id_real
statement: lemma sum_range_id_real (N : ℕ) : ∑ d ∈ Finset.range N, (d : ℝ) = (N : ℝ) * (N - 1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih => rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]; push_cast; ring

name: R56Audit.sum_range_sq_real
statement:
lemma sum_range_sq_real (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ d ∈ Finset.range N, (d : ℝ) ^ 2 = (N : ℝ) * (N - 1) * (2 * N - 1) / 6
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih => rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]; push_cast; ring

name: R56Audit.sum_centered_sq
statement:
lemma sum_centered_sq (b : ℕ) :
    ∑ d : Fin b, ((b : ℝ) - 1 - 2 * (d : ℕ)) ^ 2 = (b : ℝ) * ((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun d : ℕ => ((b : ℝ) - 1 - 2 * (d : ℝ)) ^ 2) b]
  have hexp : ∀ d : ℕ, ((b : ℝ) - 1 - 2 * (d : ℝ)) ^ 2 =
      ((b : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 - 4 * ((b : ℝ) - 1) * (d : ℝ) + 4 * (d : ℝ) ^ 2 := fun d => by ring
  simp_rw [hexp]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum,
    sum_range_id_real, sum_range_sq_real]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: R56Audit.jump_sq_eq
statement:
lemma jump_sq_eq {b : ℕ} (ε : Fin n → ℝ) (hε : ∀ i, |ε i| = 1) (i : Fin n) (d : Fin b) :
    jump b ε i d ^ 2 = ((((d : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) - ((b : ℝ) + 1) / 2) ^ 2 / (b : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hε2 : ε i ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← sq_abs, hε i]; norm_num
  unfold jump
  rw [mul_pow, hε2]
  ring

name: R56Audit.finAvg_childIndex
statement:
lemma finAvg_childIndex {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    finAvg (fun d : Fin b => ((d : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) = ((b : ℝ) + 1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (b : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hb.ne'
  
  have hsum : ∑ d : Fin b, (((d : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) = (b : ℝ) * ((b : ℝ) + 1) / 2 := by
    have h := sum_range_id_real (b + 1)
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ'] at h
    push_cast at h
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun d : ℕ => (d : ℝ) + 1) b]
    linarith
  
  unfold finAvg
  rw [hsum, Fintype.card_fin]
  field_simp

name: R56Audit.finAvg_childIndex_sq
statement:
lemma finAvg_childIndex_sq {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    finAvg (fun d : Fin b => (((d : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) = ((b : ℝ) + 1) * (2 * b + 1) / 6
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (b : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hb.ne'
  
  have hsum : ∑ d : Fin b, (((d : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 =
      (b : ℝ) * ((b : ℝ) + 1) * (2 * b + 1) / 6 := by
    have h := sum_range_sq_real (b + 1)
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ'] at h
    push_cast at h
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun d : ℕ => ((d : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) b]
    linarith
  
  unfold finAvg
  rw [hsum, Fintype.card_fin]
  field_simp

name: R56Audit.finAvg_childIndex_var
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty (Fin b) := ⟨⟨0, hb⟩⟩
  refine ⟨?_, by ring⟩
  
  have hexp : ∀ d : Fin b, ((((d : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) - ((b : ℝ) + 1) / 2) ^ 2 =
      (((d : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 - ((b : ℝ) + 1) * (((d : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) + ((b : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / 4 :=
    fun d => by ring
  
  rw [finAvg_congr hexp, finAvg_add, finAvg_sub, finAvg_const_mul, finAvg_const,
    finAvg_childIndex_sq hb, finAvg_childIndex hb]
  ring

name: R56Audit.finAvg_jump_sq
statement:
lemma finAvg_jump_sq {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (ε : Fin n → ℝ) (hε : ∀ i, |ε i| = 1) (i : Fin n) :
    finAvg (fun d : Fin b => jump b ε i d ^ 2) = ((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (12 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [finAvg_congr (jump_sq_eq ε hε i), finAvg_div_const]
  
  rw [(finAvg_childIndex_var hb).1, (finAvg_childIndex_var hb).2, div_div]

name: R56Audit.abs_jump_le
statement:
lemma abs_jump_le {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (ε : Fin n → ℝ) (hε : ∀ i, |ε i| = 1) (i : Fin n)
    (d : Fin b) : |jump b ε i d| ≤ ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (2 * b)
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℕ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hd1 : ((d : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast d.isLt
  unfold jump
  rw [abs_mul, hε i, one_mul, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * b)]
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

name: R56Audit.finAvg_jump_fourth_le_sq
statement:
lemma finAvg_jump_fourth_le_sq {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (ε : Fin n → ℝ) (hε : ∀ i, |ε i| = 1)
    (i : Fin n) :
    finAvg (fun d : Fin b => jump b ε i d ^ 4) ≤
      (((b : ℝ) - 1) / (2 * b)) ^ 2 * (((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (12 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  
  have hpt : ∀ d : Fin b, jump b ε i d ^ 4 ≤
      (((b : ℝ) - 1) / (2 * b)) ^ 2 * jump b ε i d ^ 2 := by
    intro d
    have h1 : jump b ε i d ^ 2 ≤ (((b : ℝ) - 1) / (2 * b)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (abs_jump_le hb ε hε i d) 2
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ jump b ε i d ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    calc jump b ε i d ^ 4 = jump b ε i d ^ 2 * jump b ε i d ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ (((b : ℝ) - 1) / (2 * b)) ^ 2 * jump b ε i d ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 h2
  
  calc finAvg (fun d : Fin b => jump b ε i d ^ 4)
      ≤ finAvg (fun d : Fin b => (((b : ℝ) - 1) / (2 * b)) ^ 2 * jump b ε i d ^ 2) :=
        finAvg_mono hpt
    _ = (((b : ℝ) - 1) / (2 * b)) ^ 2 * (((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (12 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2)) := by
        rw [finAvg_const_mul, finAvg_jump_sq hb ε hε i]

name: R56Audit.sq_mul_sigma_sq_le
proof:
:= by
  have hb1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  refine ⟨?_, by ring⟩
  
  have hs : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (12 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
