    apply div_nonneg _ (by positivity)
    nlinarith
  
  have hk : (((b : ℝ) - 1) / (2 * b)) ^ 2 ≤ ((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (4 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    rw [div_pow, show (2 * (b : ℝ)) ^ 2 = 4 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2 by ring]
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
    nlinarith
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk hs

name: R56Audit.finAvg_jump_fourth_le
statement:
lemma finAvg_jump_fourth_le {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (ε : Fin n → ℝ) (hε : ∀ i, |ε i| = 1)
    (i : Fin n) :
    finAvg (fun d : Fin b => jump b ε i d ^ 4) ≤
      3 * (((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (12 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2)) ^ 2
proof:
:=
  calc finAvg (fun d : Fin b => jump b ε i d ^ 4)
      ≤ (((b : ℝ) - 1) / (2 * b)) ^ 2 * (((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (12 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2)) :=
        finAvg_jump_fourth_le_sq hb ε hε i
    _ ≤ ((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (4 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2) * (((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (12 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2)) :=
        (sq_mul_sigma_sq_le hb).1
    _ = 3 * (((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (12 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2)) ^ 2 := (sq_mul_sigma_sq_le hb).2

name: R56Audit.sigma_mul_sqrt_eq
statement:
lemma sigma_mul_sqrt_eq {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (m : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt (((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (12 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2)) * Real.sqrt (m / 3) =
      Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (6 * b) * Real.sqrt m
proof:
:= by
  have hb1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hnum : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1 := by nlinarith
  
  have h6 : Real.sqrt (12 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2) * Real.sqrt 3 = 6 * b := by
    rw [← Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), show 12 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2 * 3 = (6 * b) ^ 2 by ring,
      Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]
  
  rw [Real.sqrt_div hnum, Real.sqrt_div (Nat.cast_nonneg m), div_mul_div_comm, h6]
  ring

name: R56Audit.sqrt_sq_sub_one_div_ge
statement:
lemma sqrt_sq_sub_one_div_ge {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (m : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt m / 8 ≤ Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (6 * b) * Real.sqrt m
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  
  have h16 : 9 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 16 * ((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) := by nlinarith
  
  have h34 : 3 * (b : ℝ) / 4 ≤ Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) := by
    apply Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le
    linarith [show (3 * (b : ℝ) / 4) ^ 2 = 9 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2 / 16 by ring]
  have hc : (1 : ℝ) / 8 ≤ Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (6 * b) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    linarith
  
  calc Real.sqrt m / 8 = 1 / 8 * Real.sqrt m := by ring
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (6 * b) * Real.sqrt m :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)

name: R56Audit.sqrt_div_eight_le
statement:
lemma sqrt_div_eight_le {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (m : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt m / 8 ≤
      Real.sqrt (((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (12 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2)) * Real.sqrt (m / 3)
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [sigma_mul_sqrt_eq (by omega) m]
  
  exact sqrt_sq_sub_one_div_ge hb m

name: R56Audit.expected_offset_core_sigma
statement:
theorem expected_offset_core_sigma {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (ε : Fin n → ℝ) (hε : ∀ i, |ε i| = 1)
    (V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side) (B : Fin b → Set ℝ) (hne : ∀ ℓ, (B ℓ).Nonempty)
    (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (hS : ∀ i ∈ S, side i = Side.inside ∧ (∀ y ∈ B ⟨0, by omega⟩, y < V i) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ B ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩, V i ≤ y)) :
    Real.sqrt (((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (12 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2)) * Real.sqrt (S.card / 3) ≤
      finAvg (fun r : Fin n → Fin b =>
        |mid (B ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩) (childMean ε V side r) -
          mid (B ⟨0, by omega⟩) (childMean ε V side r)|)
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by omega
  have : Nonempty (Fin b) := ⟨⟨0, hb0⟩⟩
  
  have hs2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (12 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    apply div_nonneg _ (by positivity)
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hb0
    nlinarith
  have hσ2 : Real.sqrt (((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (12 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2)) ^ 2 =
      ((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (12 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2) := Real.sq_sqrt hs2
  have hσ4 : Real.sqrt (((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (12 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2)) ^ 4 =
      (((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (12 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [show (4 : ℕ) = 2 * 2 by norm_num, pow_mul, hσ2]
  
  have hθ : ∀ r r' : Fin n → Fin b, (∀ i, i ∉ S → r i = r' i) →
      mid (B ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩) (withoutJumps b ε V side S r) -
          mid (B ⟨0, by omega⟩) (withoutJumps b ε V side S r) =
        mid (B ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩) (withoutJumps b ε V side S r') -
          mid (B ⟨0, by omega⟩) (withoutJumps b ε V side S r') := by
    intro r r' h
    rw [withoutJumps_congr b ε V side S fun i _ hi => h i hi]
  
  
  have hF : Real.sqrt (((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (12 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2)) * Real.sqrt (S.card / 3) ≤
      finAvg (fun r : Fin n → Fin b =>
        |mid (B ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩) (withoutJumps b ε V side S r) -
          mid (B ⟨0, by omega⟩) (withoutJumps b ε V side S r) + jumpSum S (jump b ε) r|) :=
    symmetric_sum_abs S (jump b ε) (fun _ => Fin.revPerm)
      (fun i _ d => jump_rev b ε i d) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      (fun i _ => by rw [hσ2]; exact finAvg_jump_sq hb0 ε hε i)
      (fun i _ => by rw [hσ4]; exact finAvg_jump_fourth_le hb0 ε hε i)
      (fun r => mid (B ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩) (withoutJumps b ε V side S r) -
        mid (B ⟨0, by omega⟩) (withoutJumps b ε V side S r)) hθ
  
  rw [finAvg_congr fun r => congrArg abs (offset_core hb ε V side B hne S hS r)]
  exact hF

name: R56Audit.expected_offset_core
statement:
theorem expected_offset_core {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (ε : Fin n → ℝ) (hε : ∀ i, |ε i| = 1)
    (V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side) (B : Fin b → Set ℝ) (hne : ∀ ℓ, (B ℓ).Nonempty)
    (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (hS : ∀ i ∈ S, side i = Side.inside ∧ (∀ y ∈ B ⟨0, by omega⟩, y < V i) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ B ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩, V i ≤ y)) :
    Real.sqrt S.card / 8 ≤
      finAvg (fun r : Fin n → Fin b =>
        |mid (B ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩) (childMean ε V side r) -
          mid (B ⟨0, by omega⟩) (childMean ε V side r)|)
proof:
:=
  (sqrt_div_eight_le hb S.card).trans (expected_offset_core_sigma hb ε hε V side B hne S hS)

name: R56Audit.expected_offset_ge_sigma
statement:
theorem expected_offset_ge_sigma {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (ε : Fin n → ℝ) (hε : ∀ i, |ε i| = 1)
    (V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side) (s : ℝ) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) :
    Real.sqrt (((b : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (12 * (b : ℝ) ^ 2)) *
        Real.sqrt ((innerPoints b V side s L).card / 3) ≤
      finAvg (fun r : Fin n → Fin b => |mid (block s L (b - 1)) (childMean ε V side r) -
        mid (block s L 0) (childMean ε V side r)|)
proof:
:=
  expected_offset_core_sigma hb ε hε V side (fun ℓ : Fin b => block s L ℓ)
    (fun ℓ => block_nonempty s hL ℓ) (innerPoints b V side s L)
    (innerPoints_between_blocks hb V side s L)

name: R56Audit.expected_offset_ge
statement:
theorem expected_offset_ge {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (ε : Fin n → ℝ) (hε : ∀ i, |ε i| = 1)
    (V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side) (s : ℝ) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) :
    Real.sqrt (innerPoints b V side s L).card / 8 ≤
      finAvg (fun r : Fin n → Fin b => |mid (block s L (b - 1)) (childMean ε V side r) -
        mid (block s L 0) (childMean ε V side r)|)
proof:
:=
  (sqrt_div_eight_le hb (innerPoints b V side s L).card).trans
    (expected_offset_ge_sigma hb ε hε V side s hL)

name: R56Audit.local_gain_core
statement:
theorem local_gain_core {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (ε : Fin n → ℝ) (hε : ∀ i, |ε i| = 1)
    (V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side) (J : Set ℝ) (B : Fin b → Set ℝ)
    (hne : ∀ ℓ, (B ℓ).Nonempty) (hsub : ∀ ℓ, B ℓ ⊆ J) (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (hS : ∀ i ∈ S, side i = Side.inside ∧ (∀ y ∈ B ⟨0, by omega⟩, y < V i) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ B ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩, V i ≤ y))
    (hcomp : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, (f '' J).Finite →
      ∑ ℓ : Fin b, osc (B ℓ) f +
          2 * |mid (B ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩) f - mid (B ⟨0, by omega⟩) f| ≤ b * osc J f) :
    ∑ ℓ : Fin b, osc (B ℓ) (endpointAvg ε V side) + (1 / 4) * Real.sqrt S.card ≤
      finAvg (fun r : Fin n → Fin b => ∑ k : Fin b, osc J (childAvg ε V side r k))
proof:
:= by
  have h8 := expected_comparison_core hb ε V side J B hne hsub hcomp
  have h4 := expected_offset_core hb ε hε V side B hne S hS
  
  linarith

name: R56Audit.local_gain_sets
statement:
theorem local_gain_sets {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (ε : Fin n → ℝ) (hε : ∀ i, |ε i| = 1)
    (V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side) (J : Set ℝ) (B : Fin b → Set ℝ)
    (hne : ∀ ℓ, (B ℓ).Nonempty) (hsub : ∀ ℓ, B ℓ ⊆ J) (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (hS : ∀ i ∈ S, side i = Side.inside ∧ (∀ y ∈ B ⟨0, by omega⟩, y < V i) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ B ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩, V i ≤ y)) :
    ∑ ℓ : Fin b, osc (B ℓ) (endpointAvg ε V side) + (1 / 4) * Real.sqrt S.card ≤
      finAvg (fun r : Fin n → Fin b => ∑ k : Fin b, osc J (childAvg ε V side r k))
proof:
:=
  local_gain_core hb ε hε V side J B hne hsub S hS
    fun f hf => vertical_comparison_sets hb J B hne hsub f hf

name: R56Audit.local_gain
statement:
theorem local_gain {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (ε : Fin n → ℝ) (hε : ∀ i, |ε i| = 1)
    (V : Fin n → ℝ) (side : Fin n → Side) (s : ℝ) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) :
    ∑ ℓ : Fin b, osc (block s L ℓ) (endpointAvg ε V side) +
        (1 / 4) * Real.sqrt (innerPoints b V side s L).card ≤
      finAvg (fun r : Fin n → Fin b =>
        ∑ k : Fin b, osc (Set.Ico s (s + b * L)) (childAvg ε V side r k))
proof:
:= by
  have h8 := display_8 hb ε V side s hL
  have h4 := expected_offset_ge hb ε hε V side s hL
  
  linarith

name: R56Audit.maxOn_mem
statement:
lemma maxOn_mem {B : Set α} {f : α → ℝ} (hB : B.Nonempty) (hf : (f '' B).Finite) :
    ∃ y ∈ B, f y = maxOn B f
proof:
:=
  (hB.image f).csSup_mem hf

name: R56Audit.minOn_mem
statement:
lemma minOn_mem {B : Set α} {f : α → ℝ} (hB : B.Nonempty) (hf : (f '' B).Finite) :
    ∃ y ∈ B, f y = minOn B f
proof:
:=
  (hB.image f).csInf_mem hf

name: R56Audit.le_maxOn
statement:
lemma le_maxOn {B : Set α} {f : α → ℝ} (hf : (f '' B).Finite) {y : α} (hy : y ∈ B) :
    f y ≤ maxOn B f
proof:
:=
  le_csSup hf.bddAbove (Set.mem_image_of_mem f hy)

name: R56Audit.minOn_le
statement:
lemma minOn_le {B : Set α} {f : α → ℝ} (hf : (f '' B).Finite) {y : α} (hy : y ∈ B) :
    minOn B f ≤ f y
proof:
:=
  csInf_le hf.bddBelow (Set.mem_image_of_mem f hy)

name: R56Audit.maxOn_le
statement:
lemma maxOn_le {B : Set α} {f : α → ℝ} (hB : B.Nonempty) {c : ℝ} (h : ∀ y ∈ B, f y ≤ c) :
    maxOn B f ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  apply csSup_le (hB.image f)
  rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  exact h y hy

name: R56Audit.le_minOn
statement:
lemma le_minOn {B : Set α} {f : α → ℝ} (hB : B.Nonempty) {c : ℝ} (h : ∀ y ∈ B, c ≤ f y) :
    c ≤ minOn B f
proof:
:= by
  apply le_csInf (hB.image f)
  rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  exact h y hy

name: R56Audit.maxOn_eq_mid_add
statement: lemma maxOn_eq_mid_add (B : Set α) (f : α → ℝ) : maxOn B f = mid B f + osc B f / 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold mid osc; ring

name: R56Audit.minOn_eq_mid_sub
statement: lemma minOn_eq_mid_sub (B : Set α) (f : α → ℝ) : minOn B f = mid B f - osc B f / 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold mid osc; ring

name: R56Audit.minOn_le_maxOn
statement:
lemma minOn_le_maxOn {B : Set α} {f : α → ℝ} (hB : B.Nonempty) (hf : (f '' B).Finite) :
    minOn B f ≤ maxOn B f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hB
  exact (minOn_le hf hy).trans (le_maxOn hf hy)

name: R56Audit.osc_nonneg
statement:
lemma osc_nonneg {B : Set α} {f : α → ℝ} (hB : B.Nonempty) (hf : (f '' B).Finite) :
    0 ≤ osc B f
proof:
:=
  sub_nonneg.mpr (minOn_le_maxOn hB hf)

name: R56Audit.sub_le_osc
statement:
lemma sub_le_osc {B : Set α} {f : α → ℝ} (hf : (f '' B).Finite) {y y' : α} (hy : y ∈ B)
    (hy' : y' ∈ B) : f y - f y' ≤ osc B f
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := le_maxOn hf hy
  have h2 := minOn_le hf hy'
  unfold osc
  linarith

name: R56Audit.osc_le
statement:
lemma osc_le {B : Set α} {f : α → ℝ} (hB : B.Nonempty) {c : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ y ∈ B, ∀ y' ∈ B, f y - f y' ≤ c) : osc B f ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : maxOn B f ≤ minOn B f + c := by
    apply maxOn_le hB
    intro y hy
    have : f y - c ≤ minOn B f := le_minOn hB (fun y' hy' => by linarith [h y hy y' hy'])
    linarith
  unfold osc
  linarith

name: R56Audit.maxOn_mono
statement:
lemma maxOn_mono {A B : Set α} {f : α → ℝ} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hAB : A ⊆ B)
    (hf : (f '' B).Finite) : maxOn A f ≤ maxOn B f
proof:
:=
  maxOn_le hA fun _ hy => le_maxOn hf (hAB hy)

name: R56Audit.minOn_anti
statement:
lemma minOn_anti {A B : Set α} {f : α → ℝ} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hAB : A ⊆ B)
    (hf : (f '' B).Finite) : minOn B f ≤ minOn A f
proof:
:=
  le_minOn hA fun _ hy => minOn_le hf (hAB hy)

name: R56Audit.maxOn_congr
statement:
lemma maxOn_congr {B : Set α} {f g : α → ℝ} (h : ∀ y ∈ B, f y = g y) :
    maxOn B f = maxOn B g
proof:
:= by
  unfold maxOn
  rw [Set.image_congr h]

name: R56Audit.minOn_congr
statement:
lemma minOn_congr {B : Set α} {f g : α → ℝ} (h : ∀ y ∈ B, f y = g y) :
    minOn B f = minOn B g
proof:
:= by
  unfold minOn
  rw [Set.image_congr h]

name: R56Audit.osc_congr
statement: lemma osc_congr {B : Set α} {f g : α → ℝ} (h : ∀ y ∈ B, f y = g y) : osc B f = osc B g
proof:
:= by
  unfold osc
  rw [maxOn_congr h, minOn_congr h]

name: R56Audit.mid_congr
statement: lemma mid_congr {B : Set α} {f g : α → ℝ} (h : ∀ y ∈ B, f y = g y) : mid B f = mid B g
proof:
:= by
  unfold mid
  rw [maxOn_congr h, minOn_congr h]

name: R56Audit.osc_const_mul
statement:
theorem osc_const_mul (B : Set α) (f : α → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    osc B (fun y => c * f y) = |c| * osc B f
proof:
:= by
  unfold osc maxOn minOn
  simp only [sSup_image', sInf_image']
  rcases le_total 0 c with hc | hc
  · 
    rw [← Real.mul_iSup_of_nonneg hc, ← Real.mul_iInf_of_nonneg hc, abs_of_nonneg hc]
    ring
  · 
    rw [← Real.mul_iInf_of_nonpos hc, ← Real.mul_iSup_of_nonpos hc, abs_of_nonpos hc]
    ring

name: R56Audit.maxOn_add_const
statement:
lemma maxOn_add_const {B : Set α} {f : α → ℝ} (hB : B.Nonempty) (hf : (f '' B).Finite)
    (c : ℝ) : maxOn B (fun y => f y + c) = maxOn B f + c
proof:
:= by
  have hfc : ((fun y => f y + c) '' B).Finite := by
    have : (fun y => f y + c) '' B = (fun t => t + c) '' (f '' B) := by
      rw [Set.image_image]
    rw [this]
    exact hf.image _
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact maxOn_le hB fun y hy => by linarith [le_maxOn hf hy]
  · have : maxOn B f ≤ maxOn B (fun y => f y + c) - c :=
      maxOn_le hB fun y hy => by linarith [le_maxOn hfc hy]
    linarith

name: R56Audit.minOn_add_const
statement:
lemma minOn_add_const {B : Set α} {f : α → ℝ} (hB : B.Nonempty) (hf : (f '' B).Finite)
    (c : ℝ) : minOn B (fun y => f y + c) = minOn B f + c
proof:
:= by
  have hfc : ((fun y => f y + c) '' B).Finite := by
    have : (fun y => f y + c) '' B = (fun t => t + c) '' (f '' B) := by
      rw [Set.image_image]
    rw [this]
    exact hf.image _
  apply le_antisymm
  · have : minOn B (fun y => f y + c) - c ≤ minOn B f :=
      le_minOn hB fun y hy => by linarith [minOn_le hfc hy]
    linarith
  · exact le_minOn hB fun y hy => by linarith [minOn_le hf hy]

name: R56Audit.osc_add_const
statement:
lemma osc_add_const {B : Set α} {f : α → ℝ} (hB : B.Nonempty) (hf : (f '' B).Finite)
    (c : ℝ) : osc B (fun y => f y + c) = osc B f
proof:
:= by
  unfold osc
  rw [maxOn_add_const hB hf, minOn_add_const hB hf]
  ring

name: R56Audit.mid_add_const
statement:
lemma mid_add_const {B : Set α} {f : α → ℝ} (hB : B.Nonempty) (hf : (f '' B).Finite)
    (c : ℝ) : mid B (fun y => f y + c) = mid B f + c
proof:
:= by
  unfold mid
  rw [maxOn_add_const hB hf, minOn_add_const hB hf]
  ring

name: R56Audit.maxOn_add_le
statement:
lemma maxOn_add_le {B : Set α} {f g : α → ℝ} (hB : B.Nonempty) (hf : (f '' B).Finite)
    (hg : (g '' B).Finite) : maxOn B (fun y => f y + g y) ≤ maxOn B f + maxOn B g
proof:
:=
  
  maxOn_le hB fun _ hy => add_le_add (le_maxOn hf hy) (le_maxOn hg hy)

name: R56Audit.add_minOn_le
statement:
lemma add_minOn_le {B : Set α} {f g : α → ℝ} (hB : B.Nonempty) (hf : (f '' B).Finite)
    (hg : (g '' B).Finite) : minOn B f + minOn B g ≤ minOn B (fun y => f y + g y)
proof:
:=
  
  le_minOn hB fun _ hy => add_le_add (minOn_le hf hy) (minOn_le hg hy)

name: R56Audit.osc_add_le
statement:
lemma osc_add_le {B : Set α} {f g : α → ℝ} (hB : B.Nonempty) (hf : (f '' B).Finite)
    (hg : (g '' B).Finite) : osc B (fun y => f y + g y) ≤ osc B f + osc B g
proof:
:= by
  
  have h1 := maxOn_add_le hB hf hg
  have h2 := add_minOn_le hB hf hg
  
  unfold osc
  linarith

name: R56Audit.osc_neg
statement: lemma osc_neg (B : Set α) (g : α → ℝ) : osc B (fun y => -g y) = osc B g
proof:
:= by
  have h : (fun y => -g y) = fun y => -1 * g y := funext fun y => (neg_one_mul (g y)).symm
  rw [h, osc_const_mul, abs_neg, abs_one, one_mul]

name: R56Audit.osc_sum_le
statement:
lemma osc_sum_le {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) {B : Set α} {f : ι → α → ℝ} (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (hf : ∀ k ∈ s, ((f k) '' B).Finite) :
    osc B (fun y => ∑ k ∈ s, f k y) ≤ ∑ k ∈ s, osc B (f k)
proof:
:=
  osc_le hB fun y hy y' hy' => by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun k hk => sub_le_osc (hf k hk) hy hy'

name: R56Audit.card_mul_osc_avg_le
statement:
lemma card_mul_osc_avg_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] {B : Set α} {f : ι → α → ℝ}
    (hB : B.Nonempty) (hf : ∀ k, ((f k) '' B).Finite) :
    (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * osc B (fun y => (∑ k, f k y) / Fintype.card ι) ≤
      ∑ k, osc B (f k)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card ι := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  
  have hsum : (fun y => ∑ k, f k y) =
      fun y => (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * ((∑ k, f k y) / Fintype.card ι) := by
    funext y
    field_simp
  calc (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * osc B (fun y => (∑ k, f k y) / Fintype.card ι)
      = osc B (fun y => (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * ((∑ k, f k y) / Fintype.card ι)) := by
        rw [osc_const_mul, abs_of_pos hc]
    _ = osc B (fun y => ∑ k, f k y) := by rw [← hsum]
    _ ≤ ∑ k, osc B (f k) := osc_sum_le Finset.univ hB fun k _ => hf k

name: R56Audit.block_nonempty
statement: lemma block_nonempty (s : ℝ) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (ℓ : ℕ) : (block s L ℓ).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  ⟨s + ℓ * L, ⟨le_rfl, by nlinarith⟩⟩

name: R56Audit.block_subset
statement:
lemma block_subset (s : ℝ) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) {b ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ : ℓ < b) :
    block s L ℓ ⊆ Set.Ico s (s + b * L)
proof:
:= by
  rintro y ⟨h1, h2⟩
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ℓ := Nat.cast_nonneg ℓ
  have hb : (ℓ : ℝ) + 1 ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hℓ
  constructor
  · nlinarith
  · nlinarith

name: R56Audit.iUnion_block
statement:
lemma iUnion_block (s : ℝ) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (b : ℕ) :
    ⋃ ℓ : Fin b, block s L ℓ = Set.Ico s (s + b * L)
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact Set.iUnion_subset fun ℓ => block_subset s hL ℓ.isLt
  · rintro y ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have hq : 0 ≤ (y - s) / L := div_nonneg (by linarith) hL.le
    have hlt : (y - s) / L < b := (div_lt_iff₀ hL).mpr (by linarith)
    have hfl : ⌊(y - s) / L⌋₊ < b := (Nat.floor_lt hq).mpr hlt
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨⌊(y - s) / L⌋₊, hfl⟩, ?_⟩
    have hle : (⌊(y - s) / L⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ (y - s) / L := Nat.floor_le hq
    have hlt' : (y - s) / L < ⌊(y - s) / L⌋₊ + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
    constructor
    · have := (le_div_iff₀ hL).mp hle
      change s + (⌊(y - s) / L⌋₊ : ℝ) * L ≤ y
      linarith
    · have := (div_lt_iff₀ hL).mp hlt'
      change y < s + ((⌊(y - s) / L⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1) * L
      linarith

name: R56Audit.block_disjoint
statement:
lemma block_disjoint (s : ℝ) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) {ℓ ℓ' : ℕ} (h : ℓ ≠ ℓ') :
    Disjoint (block s L ℓ) (block s L ℓ')
proof:
:= by
  wlog hlt : ℓ < ℓ' generalizing ℓ ℓ'
  · exact (this h.symm (lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hlt) h.symm)).symm
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro y ⟨-, h2⟩ ⟨h3, -⟩
  have : (ℓ : ℝ) + 1 ≤ ℓ' := by exact_mod_cast hlt
  nlinarith

name: R56Audit.iUnion_inner_blocks
statement:
theorem iUnion_inner_blocks (s : ℝ) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) :
    ⋃ ℓ ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (b - 1), block s L ℓ = Set.Ico (s + L) (s + ((b : ℝ) - 1) * L)
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · 
    refine Set.iUnion₂_subset fun ℓ hℓ => ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hℓ
    rintro y ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have h1' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ℓ := by exact_mod_cast hℓ.1
    have h2' : (ℓ : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (b : ℝ) - 1 := by
      have h : ℓ + 1 + 1 ≤ b := by omega
      have h' : ((ℓ + 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast h
      push_cast at h'
      linarith
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  · 
    
    rintro y ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have hbR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hb
    have hy : y ∈ Set.Ico s (s + b * L) := ⟨by linarith, by nlinarith⟩
    rw [← iUnion_block s hL b] at hy
    obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ1, hℓ2⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨ℓ, Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩, hℓ1, hℓ2⟩
    · 
      by_contra h0
      have h0' : (ℓ : ℕ) = 0 := by omega
      rw [h0'] at hℓ2
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, one_mul] at hℓ2
      linarith
    · 
      by_contra hlast
      have hlast' : (b : ℝ) - 1 ≤ (ℓ : ℕ) := by
        have h : b ≤ (ℓ : ℕ) + 1 := by omega
        have h' : (b : ℝ) ≤ ((ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast h
        linarith
      nlinarith

name: R56Audit.inner_blocks_nonempty
statement:
theorem inner_blocks_nonempty (s : ℝ) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) {b : ℕ} (hb : 3 ≤ b) :
    (Set.Ico (s + L) (s + ((b : ℝ) - 1) * L)).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (3 : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  exact Set.nonempty_Ico.mpr (by nlinarith)

name: R56Audit.osc_mono
statement:
lemma osc_mono {A J : Set α} {f : α → ℝ} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hAJ : A ⊆ J)
    (hf : (f '' J).Finite) : osc A f ≤ osc J f
proof:
:= by
  
  have h1 := maxOn_mono hA hAJ hf
  have h2 := minOn_anti hA hAJ hf
  unfold osc
  linarith

name: R56Audit.maxOn_sub_minOn_le_osc
statement:
lemma maxOn_sub_minOn_le_osc {A C J : Set α} {f : α → ℝ} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hC : C.Nonempty)
    (hAJ : A ⊆ J) (hCJ : C ⊆ J) (hf : (f '' J).Finite) : maxOn C f - minOn A f ≤ osc J f
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have h1 := maxOn_mono hC hCJ hf
  have h2 := minOn_anti hA hAJ hf
  unfold osc
  linarith

name: R56Audit.maxOn_sub_minOn_eq
statement:
lemma maxOn_sub_minOn_eq (A C : Set α) (f : α → ℝ) :
    maxOn C f - minOn A f = (osc A f + osc C f) / 2 + (mid C f - mid A f)
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [maxOn_eq_mid_add C f, minOn_eq_mid_sub A f]
  ring

name: R56Audit.half_osc_add_abs_mid_sub_le
statement:
theorem half_osc_add_abs_mid_sub_le {A C J : Set α} {f : α → ℝ} (hA : A.Nonempty)
    (hC : C.Nonempty) (hAJ : A ⊆ J) (hCJ : C ⊆ J) (hf : (f '' J).Finite) :
    (osc A f + osc C f) / 2 + |mid C f - mid A f| ≤ osc J f
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have h1 : (osc A f + osc C f) / 2 + (mid C f - mid A f) ≤ osc J f :=
    (maxOn_sub_minOn_eq A C f).symm.trans_le (maxOn_sub_minOn_le_osc hA hC hAJ hCJ hf)
  
  
  have h2 : (osc A f + osc C f) / 2 - (mid C f - mid A f) ≤ osc J f := by
    have h := (maxOn_sub_minOn_eq C A f).symm.trans_le
      (maxOn_sub_minOn_le_osc hC hA hCJ hAJ hf)
    linarith
  
  rcases le_total 0 (mid C f - mid A f) with H | H
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg H]
    exact h1
  · rw [abs_of_nonpos H]
    linarith

name: R56Audit.vertical_comparison_sets
statement:
theorem vertical_comparison_sets {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (J : Set α) (B : Fin b → Set α)
    (hne : ∀ ℓ, (B ℓ).Nonempty) (hsub : ∀ ℓ, B ℓ ⊆ J) (f : α → ℝ) (hf : (f '' J).Finite) :
    ∑ ℓ : Fin b, osc (B ℓ) f +
        2 * |mid (B ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩) f - mid (B ⟨0, by omega⟩) f| ≤ b * osc J f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hfirst : (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin b) ≠ ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩ := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp only at this
    omega
  
  have h2 := half_osc_add_abs_mid_sub_le (hne (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin b))
    (hne (⟨b - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin b)) (hsub _) (hsub _) hf
  
  have h1 : ∀ ℓ, osc (B ℓ) f ≤ osc J f := fun ℓ => osc_mono (hne ℓ) (hsub ℓ) hf
  have hrest : ∑ ℓ ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin b)).erase ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩,
      osc (B ℓ) f ≤ ((b : ℝ) - 2) * osc J f := by
    calc ∑ ℓ ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin b)).erase ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩, osc (B ℓ) f
        ≤ ∑ _ℓ ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin b)).erase ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩, osc J f :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun ℓ _ => h1 ℓ
      _ = ((b : ℝ) - 2) * osc J f := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_erase_of_mem
            (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hfirst.symm, Finset.mem_univ _⟩),
            Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ _), Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
            nsmul_eq_mul]
          have : ((b - 1 - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (b : ℝ) - 2 := by
            rw [Nat.sub_sub, Nat.cast_sub hb]
            norm_num
          rw [this]
  
  have e1 := Finset.add_sum_erase Finset.univ (fun ℓ : Fin b => osc (B ℓ) f)
    (Finset.mem_univ (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin b))
  have e2 := Finset.add_sum_erase (Finset.univ.erase (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin b))
    (fun ℓ : Fin b => osc (B ℓ) f) (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hfirst.symm, Finset.mem_univ _⟩)
  linarith

name: R56Audit.vertical_comparison
statement:
theorem vertical_comparison {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (s : ℝ) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : (f '' Set.Ico s (s + b * L)).Finite) :
    ∑ ℓ : Fin b, osc (block s L ℓ) f +
        2 * |mid (block s L (b - 1)) f - mid (block s L 0) f| ≤
      b * osc (Set.Ico s (s + b * L)) f
proof:
:=
  vertical_comparison_sets hb (Set.Ico s (s + b * L)) (fun ℓ : Fin b => block s L ℓ)
    (fun ℓ => block_nonempty s hL ℓ) (fun ℓ => block_subset s hL ℓ.isLt) f hf

name: R56Audit.mem_heavySet
statement:
lemma mem_heavySet {b h j : ℕ} {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ} {p : Fin (b ^ j) × Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1))} :
    p ∈ heavySet b h j P ↔ Heavy b h j P p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  simp [heavySet]

name: R56Audit.mem_smallCollections
statement:
lemma mem_smallCollections {b h j : ℕ} {𝒮 : Finset (Fin (b ^ j) × Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)))} :
    𝒮 ∈ smallCollections b h j ↔ (𝒮.card : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / b
proof:
:= by
  simp [smallCollections]

name: R56Audit.mem_Wset
statement:
lemma mem_Wset {b h j : ℕ} {𝒮 : Finset (Fin (b ^ j) × Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)))} {z : ℝ × ℝ} :
    z ∈ Wset b h j 𝒮 ↔
      z ∈ boundaryStrips b h j ∨ ∃ p ∈ 𝒮, z ∈ innerRegion b h j p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Wset, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_iUnion₂, exists_prop]

name: R56Audit.card_compRect
statement:
lemma card_compRect {b h j : ℕ} (hj : j < h) :
    Fintype.card (Fin (b ^ j) × Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1))) = b ^ (h - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin, ← pow_add]
  congr 1
  omega

name: R56Audit.bottomStrip_eq
statement:
lemma bottomStrip_eq (b h j c v : ℕ) :
    bottomStrip b h j c v =
      Set.Icc ((c : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ j) (((c : ℝ) + 1) / (b : ℝ) ^ j) ×ˢ vcell b h j (b * v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold bottomStrip vcell vlen
  push_cast
  congr 2 <;> ring

name: R56Audit.topStrip_eq
statement:
lemma topStrip_eq {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h j c v : ℕ) :
    topStrip b h j c v =
      Set.Icc ((c : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ j) (((c : ℝ) + 1) / (b : ℝ) ^ j) ×ˢ
        vcell b h j (b * v + (b - 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold topStrip vcell vlen
  push_cast [Nat.cast_pred hb]
  congr 2 <;> ring

name: R56Audit.prod_vcell_subset_innerRegion
statement:
lemma prod_vcell_subset_innerRegion {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h j c v : ℕ) {ℓ : ℕ} (h1 : 1 ≤ ℓ)
    (h2 : ℓ + 2 ≤ b) :
    Set.Icc ((c : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ j) (((c : ℝ) + 1) / (b : ℝ) ^ j) ×ˢ vcell b h j (b * v + ℓ) ⊆
      innerRegion b h j c v
proof:
:= by
  have hL := vlen_pos hb h j
  
  have e1 : ((v : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) + (b : ℝ) ^ j) / (b : ℝ) ^ h =
      ((b : ℝ) * v + 1) * vlen b h j := by
    unfold vlen
    ring
  have e2 : (((v : ℝ) + 1) * (b : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) - (b : ℝ) ^ j) / (b : ℝ) ^ h =
      ((b : ℝ) * v + b - 1) * vlen b h j := by
    unfold vlen
    ring
  have h1R : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ℓ := by exact_mod_cast h1
  have h2R : (ℓ : ℝ) + 2 ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast h2
  rintro ⟨x, y⟩ ⟨hx, hy1, hy2⟩
  push_cast at hy1 hy2
  refine Set.mk_mem_prod hx ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [e1]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hL.le).trans hy1
  · rw [e2]
    exact hy2.trans_le (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hL.le)

name: R56Audit.innerRegion_inj
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hpj : (0 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ j := by positivity
  have hpj1 : (0 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) := by positivity
  have hph : (0 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ h := by positivity
  obtain ⟨⟨hx1, hx2⟩, hy1, hy2⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨⟨hx1', hx2'⟩, hy1', hy2'⟩ := h2
  
  have auxh : ∀ {a a' : ℕ}, (a : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ j ≤ z.1 →
      z.1 ≤ ((a' : ℝ) + 1) / (b : ℝ) ^ j → a ≤ a' := by
    intro a a' ha ha'
    have hne := hz (a' + 1)
    push_cast at hne
    have hlt : (a : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ j < ((a' : ℝ) + 1) / (b : ℝ) ^ j :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt ha (lt_of_le_of_ne ha' hne)
    have hlt' : (a : ℝ) < (a' : ℝ) + 1 := (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hpj).mp hlt
    have : a < a' + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hlt'
    omega
  
  have auxv : ∀ {a a' : ℕ}, ((a : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) + (b : ℝ) ^ j) / (b : ℝ) ^ h ≤ z.2 →
      z.2 < (((a' : ℝ) + 1) * (b : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) - (b : ℝ) ^ j) / (b : ℝ) ^ h → a ≤ a' := by
    intro a a' ha ha'
    have hlt := (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hph).mp (lt_of_le_of_lt ha ha')
    by_contra hcon
    have hcon' : (a' : ℝ) + 1 ≤ a := by exact_mod_cast not_le.mp hcon
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcon' hpj1.le
    linarith
  exact ⟨le_antisymm (auxh hx1 hx2') (auxh hx1' hx2),
    le_antisymm (auxv hy1 hy2') (auxv hy1' hy2)⟩

name: R56Audit.sum_innerCount_le
statement:
lemma sum_innerCount_le {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ} (hgrid : NoGrid b P)
    (𝒮 : Finset (Fin (b ^ j) × Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)))) :
    ∑ p ∈ 𝒮, innerCount b h j P p.1 p.2 ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  
  have hdisj : (𝒮 : Set (Fin (b ^ j) × Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)))).PairwiseDisjoint
      (fun p => Finset.univ.filter (fun i => P i ∈ innerRegion b h j p.1 p.2)) := by
    intro p _ p' _ hne
    refine Finset.disjoint_left.mpr fun i hi hi' => hne ?_
    have hz : ∀ k : ℕ, (P i).1 ≠ (k : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ j := fun k => by
      have := (hgrid i (k : ℤ) j).1
      push_cast at this
      exact this
    have := innerRegion_inj hb hz (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi').2
    exact Prod.ext (Fin.ext this.1) (Fin.ext this.2)
  calc ∑ p ∈ 𝒮, innerCount b h j P p.1 p.2
      = (𝒮.biUnion fun p =>
          Finset.univ.filter (fun i => P i ∈ innerRegion b h j p.1 p.2)).card :=
        (Finset.card_biUnion hdisj).symm
    _ ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).card := Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_univ _)
    _ = n := by simp

name: R56Audit.card_heavySet_lt
statement:
theorem card_heavySet_lt {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ} (hgrid : NoGrid b P) :
    ((heavySet b h j P).card : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / b
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hM : (0 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) := by positivity
  rcases (heavySet b h j P).eq_empty_or_nonempty with hH | hH
  · rw [hH, Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero]
    positivity
  
  have h1 : ∑ _p ∈ heavySet b h j P, (b : ℝ) * n / (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) <
      ∑ p ∈ heavySet b h j P, (innerCount b h j P p.1 p.2 : ℝ) :=
    Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty hH fun p hp => mem_heavySet.mp hp
  
  have h2 : ∑ p ∈ heavySet b h j P, (innerCount b h j P p.1 p.2 : ℝ) ≤ n := by
    exact_mod_cast sum_innerCount_le hb hgrid (heavySet b h j P)
  rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul] at h1
  
  have h3 : ((heavySet b h j P).card : ℝ) * ((b : ℝ) * n / (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1)) < n :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le h1 h2
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < n := lt_of_le_of_lt (by positivity) h3
  rw [lt_div_iff₀ hbR]
  have h4 : ((heavySet b h j P).card : ℝ) * b * n < (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) * n := by
    have h5 : ((heavySet b h j P).card : ℝ) * ((b : ℝ) * n / (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1)) =
        ((heavySet b h j P).card : ℝ) * b * n / (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) := by ring
    rw [h5, div_lt_iff₀ hM] at h3
    linarith
  exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right h4 hn.le

name: R56Audit.exists_hcell
statement:
lemma exists_hcell {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (j : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ c, c < b ^ j ∧ x ∈ Set.Icc ((c : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ j) (((c : ℝ) + 1) / (b : ℝ) ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hN : 0 < b ^ j := pow_pos hb j
  have hNR : (0 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ j := by positivity
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hx.2 with hlt | heq
  · 
    have h0 : 0 ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ j * x := mul_nonneg hNR.le hx.1
    refine ⟨⌊(b : ℝ) ^ j * x⌋₊, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Nat.floor_lt h0]
      push_cast
      exact mul_lt_of_lt_one_right hNR hlt
    · rw [div_le_iff₀ hNR]
      linarith [Nat.floor_le h0]
    · rw [le_div_iff₀ hNR]
      linarith [Nat.lt_floor_add_one ((b : ℝ) ^ j * x)]
  · 
    have hc : ((b ^ j - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (b : ℝ) ^ j - 1 := by
      rw [Nat.cast_pred hN, Nat.cast_pow]
    refine ⟨b ^ j - 1, Nat.sub_lt hN one_pos, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hc, heq, div_le_one hNR]
      linarith
    · rw [hc, heq, sub_add_cancel, div_self hNR.ne']

name: R56Audit.exists_vcell
statement:
lemma exists_vcell {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hj : j ≤ h) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ w, w < b ^ (h - j) ∧ y ∈ vcell b h j w
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hL : (0 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ (h - j) := by positivity
  
  have hvl : vlen b h j = 1 / (b : ℝ) ^ (h - j) := by
    unfold vlen
    rw [div_eq_div_iff (by positivity) (by positivity), one_mul, ← pow_add,
      Nat.add_sub_cancel' hj]
  have h0 : 0 ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ (h - j) * y := mul_nonneg hL.le hy.1
  refine ⟨⌊(b : ℝ) ^ (h - j) * y⌋₊, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Nat.floor_lt h0]
    push_cast
    exact mul_lt_of_lt_one_right hL hy.2
  · rw [hvl, mul_one_div, div_le_iff₀ hL]
    linarith [Nat.floor_le h0]
  · rw [hvl, mul_one_div, lt_div_iff₀ hL]
    linarith [Nat.lt_floor_add_one ((b : ℝ) ^ (h - j) * y)]

name: R56Audit.mem_boundaryStrips_or_innerRegion
statement:
theorem mem_boundaryStrips_or_innerRegion {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hj : j < h) {z : ℝ × ℝ}
    (hz1 : z.1 ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hz2 : z.2 ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    z ∈ boundaryStrips b h j ∨
      ∃ c : Fin (b ^ j), ∃ v : Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)), z ∈ innerRegion b h j c v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hx⟩ := exists_hcell hb j hz1
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hy⟩ := exists_vcell hb hj.le hz2
  
  have hv : w / b < b ^ (h - j - 1) := by
    rw [Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hb, ← pow_succ]
    have : h - j - 1 + 1 = h - j := by omega
    rwa [this]
  have hℓ : w % b < b := Nat.mod_lt _ hb
  rw [← Nat.div_add_mod w b] at hy
  have hmem : z ∈ Set.Icc ((c : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ j) (((c : ℝ) + 1) / (b : ℝ) ^ j) ×ˢ
      vcell b h j (b * (w / b) + w % b) := ⟨hx, hy⟩
  by_cases h0 : w % b = 0
  · 
    left
    rw [h0, add_zero, ← bottomStrip_eq] at hmem
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨(⟨c, hc⟩, ⟨w / b, hv⟩), Or.inl hmem⟩
  by_cases h1 : w % b = b - 1
  · 
    left
    rw [h1, ← topStrip_eq hb] at hmem
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨(⟨c, hc⟩, ⟨w / b, hv⟩), Or.inr hmem⟩
  · 
    right
    exact ⟨⟨c, hc⟩, ⟨w / b, hv⟩,
      prod_vcell_subset_innerRegion hb h j c (w / b) (by omega) (by omega) hmem⟩

name: R56Audit.mem_unit_of_inUnit_of_noGrid
statement:
lemma mem_unit_of_inUnit_of_noGrid {b : ℕ} {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ} (hP : InUnit P)
    (hgrid : NoGrid b P) (i : Fin n) :
    (P i).1 ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ (P i).2 ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (hgrid i 1 0).2
  simp only [Int.cast_one, pow_zero, div_one] at h1
  exact ⟨⟨(hP i).1.1.le, (hP i).1.2⟩, ⟨(hP i).2.1.le, lt_of_le_of_ne (hP i).2.2 h1⟩⟩

name: R56Audit.mem_Wset_heavySet
statement:
theorem mem_Wset_heavySet {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hj : j < h) {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ} {i : Fin n}
    (hi1 : (P i).1 ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hi2 : (P i).2 ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hi : ¬ ∃ c : Fin (b ^ j), ∃ v : Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)),
      P i ∈ innerRegion b h j c v ∧ ¬ Heavy b h j P c v) :
    P i ∈ Wset b h j (heavySet b h j P)
proof:
:= by
  rcases mem_boundaryStrips_or_innerRegion hb hj hi1 hi2 with hs | ⟨c, v, hin⟩
  · exact mem_Wset.mpr (Or.inl hs)
  · have hheavy : Heavy b h j P c v := by
      by_contra hnh
      exact hi ⟨c, v, hin, hnh⟩
    exact mem_Wset.mpr (Or.inr ⟨(c, v), (mem_heavySet (p := (c, v))).mpr hheavy, hin⟩)

name: R56Audit.half_lt_card_Wset
statement:
theorem half_lt_card_Wset {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hj : j < h) {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ}
    (hP : ∀ i, (P i).1 ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ (P i).2 ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hbad : ¬ GoodTransition b h j P) :
    (n : ℝ) / 2 <
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => P i ∈ Wset b h j (heavySet b h j P))).card
proof:
:= by
  
  set light : Finset (Fin n) := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ∃ c : Fin (b ^ j),
    ∃ v : Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)), P i ∈ innerRegion b h j c v ∧ ¬ Heavy b h j P c v)
  set other : Finset (Fin n) := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ¬ ∃ c : Fin (b ^ j),
    ∃ v : Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)), P i ∈ innerRegion b h j c v ∧ ¬ Heavy b h j P c v)
  
  have hfew : (light.card : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) / 2 := not_le.mp hbad
  have hsplit : (light.card : ℝ) + other.card = n := by
    have := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)))
      (fun i => ∃ c : Fin (b ^ j), ∃ v : Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)),
        P i ∈ innerRegion b h j c v ∧ ¬ Heavy b h j P c v)
    rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at this
    exact_mod_cast this
  
  have hsub : other ⊆ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => P i ∈ Wset b h j (heavySet b h j P)) := by
    intro i hi
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,
      mem_Wset_heavySet hb hj (hP i).1 (hP i).2 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2⟩
  have hle : (other.card : ℝ) ≤
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => P i ∈ Wset b h j (heavySet b h j P))).card := by
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card hsub
  linarith

name: R56Audit.volume_Icc_prod_Ico
statement:
lemma volume_Icc_prod_Ico {a c : ℝ} (hac : a ≤ c) (d e : ℝ) :
    volume (Set.Icc a c ×ˢ Set.Ico d e) = ENNReal.ofReal ((c - a) * (e - d))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod, Measure.prod_prod, Real.volume_Icc, Real.volume_Ico,
    ENNReal.ofReal_mul (sub_nonneg.mpr hac)]

name: R56Audit.volume_bottomStrip
statement:
lemma volume_bottomStrip {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h j c v : ℕ) :
    volume (bottomStrip b h j c v) = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (b : ℝ) ^ h)
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  unfold bottomStrip
  rw [volume_Icc_prod_Ico (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (by positivity))]
  congr 1
  field_simp
  ring

name: R56Audit.volume_topStrip
statement:
lemma volume_topStrip {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h j c v : ℕ) :
    volume (topStrip b h j c v) = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (b : ℝ) ^ h)
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  unfold topStrip
  rw [volume_Icc_prod_Ico (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (by positivity))]
  congr 1
  field_simp
  ring

name: R56Audit.volume_innerRegion
statement:
lemma volume_innerRegion {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h j c v : ℕ) :
    volume (innerRegion b h j c v) = ENNReal.ofReal (((b : ℝ) - 2) / (b : ℝ) ^ h)
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  unfold innerRegion
  rw [volume_Icc_prod_Ico (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (by positivity))]
  congr 1
  field_simp
  ring

name: R56Audit.pow_eq_mul_pow_pred
statement: lemma pow_eq_mul_pow_pred {b h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) : (b : ℝ) ^ h = b * (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_succ']
  congr 1
  omega

name: R56Audit.volume_innerRegion_lt
statement:
lemma volume_innerRegion_lt {b h : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hh : 0 < h) (j c v : ℕ) :
    volume (innerRegion b h j c v) < ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hM : (0 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) := by positivity
  rw [volume_innerRegion hb, ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (by positivity),
    pow_eq_mul_pow_pred hh, div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hM]
  linarith

name: R56Audit.disjoint_vcell_of_ne
statement:
lemma disjoint_vcell_of_ne {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h j : ℕ) {v v' : ℕ} (hv : v ≠ v') :
    Disjoint (vcell b h j v) (vcell b h j v')
proof:
:= by
  
  have e : ∀ w : ℕ, vcell b h j w = block 0 (vlen b h j) w := by
    intro w
    unfold vcell block
    rw [zero_add, zero_add]
  rw [e v, e v']
  exact block_disjoint 0 (vlen_pos hb h j) hv

name: R56Audit.vcell_subset_vcell_succ
statement:
lemma vcell_subset_vcell_succ {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h j v : ℕ) {ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ : ℓ < b) :
    vcell b h j (b * v + ℓ) ⊆ vcell b h (j + 1) v
proof:
:= by
  rw [vcell_eq_block, vcell_succ_eq]
  exact block_subset _ (vlen_pos hb h j) hℓ

name: R56Audit.iUnion_Icc_div_pow
statement:
lemma iUnion_Icc_div_pow {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (j : ℕ) :
    ⋃ c : Fin (b ^ j), Set.Icc ((c : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ j) (((c : ℝ) + 1) / (b : ℝ) ^ j) =
      Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpj : (0 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ j := by positivity
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · 
    refine Set.iUnion_subset fun c => ?_
    have hc1 : ((c : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ j := by exact_mod_cast c.isLt
    rintro x ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨le_trans (by positivity) h1, h2.trans ((div_le_one hpj).mpr hc1)⟩
  · 
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hxc⟩ := exists_hcell hb j hx
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨c, hc⟩, hxc⟩

name: R56Audit.boundaryStrips_eq_prod
statement:
lemma boundaryStrips_eq_prod {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h j : ℕ) :
    boundaryStrips b h j = Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ
      ⋃ v : Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)), (vcell b h j (b * v) ∪ vcell b h j (b * v + (b - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [← iUnion_Icc_div_pow hb j, ← Set.iUnion_prod]
  
  exact Set.iUnion_congr fun p => by rw [bottomStrip_eq, topStrip_eq hb, Set.prod_union]

name: R56Audit.volume_boundaryStrips
statement:
theorem volume_boundaryStrips {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hj : j < h) :
    volume (boundaryStrips b h j) = ENNReal.ofReal (2 / (b : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by omega
  have hL := vlen_pos hb0 h j
  
  have hvol : ∀ w : ℕ, volume (vcell b h j w) = ENNReal.ofReal (vlen b h j) := by
    intro w
    rw [vcell, Real.volume_Ico]
    congr 1
    ring
  
  have hterm : ∀ v : Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)),
      volume (vcell b h j (b * v) ∪ vcell b h j (b * v + (b - 1))) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * vlen b h j) := by
    intro v
    rw [measure_union (disjoint_vcell_of_ne hb0 h j (by omega)) measurableSet_Ico, hvol, hvol,
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_add hL.le hL.le, two_mul]
  
  
  have hsub : ∀ v : ℕ,
      vcell b h j (b * v) ∪ vcell b h j (b * v + (b - 1)) ⊆ vcell b h (j + 1) v := fun v =>
    Set.union_subset (vcell_subset_vcell_succ hb0 h j v (ℓ := 0) hb0)
      (vcell_subset_vcell_succ hb0 h j v (ℓ := b - 1) (by omega))
  
  have hdisj : Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint fun v : Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)) =>
      vcell b h j (b * v) ∪ vcell b h j (b * v + (b - 1))) := fun v v' hvv =>
    (disjoint_vcell_of_ne hb0 h (j + 1) (Fin.val_ne_of_ne hvv)).mono (hsub v) (hsub v')
  
  have hpow : (b : ℝ) ^ h = (b : ℝ) ^ (h - j - 1) * (b : ℝ) ^ j * b := by
    rw [← pow_add, ← pow_succ]
    congr 1
    omega
  calc volume (boundaryStrips b h j)
      = volume (⋃ v : Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)),
          (vcell b h j (b * v) ∪ vcell b h j (b * v + (b - 1)))) := by
        
        rw [boundaryStrips_eq_prod hb0, Measure.volume_eq_prod, Measure.prod_prod,
          Real.volume_Icc, sub_zero, ENNReal.ofReal_one, one_mul]
    _ = ∑ v : Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)),
          volume (vcell b h j (b * v) ∪ vcell b h j (b * v + (b - 1))) := by
        
        rw [measure_iUnion hdisj fun v => measurableSet_Ico.union measurableSet_Ico,
          tsum_fintype]
    _ = ∑ _v : Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)), ENNReal.ofReal (2 * vlen b h j) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _ => hterm v
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (2 / (b : ℝ)) := by
        
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul,
          ← ENNReal.ofReal_natCast, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
        congr 1
        unfold vlen
        rw [hpow]
        push_cast
        field_simp

name: R56Audit.volume_boundaryStrips_le
statement:
theorem volume_boundaryStrips_le {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hj : j < h) :
    volume (boundaryStrips b h j) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 / (b : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  calc volume (boundaryStrips b h j)
      ≤ ∑ p : Fin (b ^ j) × Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)),
          volume (bottomStrip b h j p.1 p.2 ∪ topStrip b h j p.1 p.2) :=
        measure_iUnion_fintype_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _p : Fin (b ^ j) × Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)), ENNReal.ofReal (2 / (b : ℝ) ^ h) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun p _ => (measure_union_le _ _).trans ?_
        rw [volume_bottomStrip hb, volume_topStrip hb,
          ← ENNReal.ofReal_add (by positivity) (by positivity)]
        refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (le_of_eq ?_)
        ring
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (2 / (b : ℝ)) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, card_compRect hj, nsmul_eq_mul,
          ← ENNReal.ofReal_natCast, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        rw [pow_eq_mul_pow_pred (by omega : 0 < h)]
        field_simp

name: R56Audit.volume_innerRegions_lt
statement:
theorem volume_innerRegions_lt {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hj : j < h)
    {𝒮 : Finset (Fin (b ^ j) × Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)))}
    (h𝒮 : (𝒮.card : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / b) :
    volume (⋃ p ∈ 𝒮, innerRegion b h j p.1 p.2) < ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (b : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  calc volume (⋃ p ∈ 𝒮, innerRegion b h j p.1 p.2)
      ≤ ∑ p ∈ 𝒮, volume (innerRegion b h j p.1 p.2) := measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _p ∈ 𝒮, ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun p _ => (volume_innerRegion_lt hb (by omega) j p.1 p.2).le
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (𝒮.card * (1 / (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1))) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _),
          ENNReal.ofReal_natCast]
    _ < ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (b : ℝ)) := by
        
        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (by positivity)]
        calc (𝒮.card : ℝ) * (1 / (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1))
            < (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / b * (1 / (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1)) :=
              mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h𝒮 (by positivity)
          _ = 1 / (b : ℝ) := by field_simp

name: R56Audit.volume_innerRegions_le
statement:
theorem volume_innerRegions_le {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hj : j < h)
    {𝒮 : Finset (Fin (b ^ j) × Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)))}
    (h𝒮 : (𝒮.card : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / b) :
    volume (⋃ p ∈ 𝒮, innerRegion b h j p.1 p.2) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (b : ℝ))
proof:
:=
  (volume_innerRegions_lt hb hj h𝒮).le

name: R56Audit.volume_Wset_le
statement:
theorem volume_Wset_le {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hj : j < h)
    {𝒮 : Finset (Fin (b ^ j) × Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)))}
    (h𝒮 : (𝒮.card : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / b) :
    volume (Wset b h j 𝒮) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (3 / (b : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  calc volume (Wset b h j 𝒮)
      ≤ volume (boundaryStrips b h j) + volume (⋃ p ∈ 𝒮, innerRegion b h j p.1 p.2) :=
        measure_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 / (b : ℝ)) + ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (b : ℝ)) :=
        add_le_add (volume_boundaryStrips_le hb hj) (volume_innerRegions_lt hb hj h𝒮).le
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (3 / (b : ℝ)) := by
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add (by positivity) (by positivity)]
        congr 1
        ring

name: R56Audit.unitSq_Wset_le
statement:
theorem unitSq_Wset_le {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hj : j < h)
    {𝒮 : Finset (Fin (b ^ j) × Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)))}
    (h𝒮 : (𝒮.card : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / b) :
    (volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ × ℝ) 1)) (Wset b h j 𝒮) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (3 / (b : ℝ))
proof:
:=
  (Measure.restrict_apply_le _ _).trans (volume_Wset_le hb hj h𝒮)

name: R56Audit.unifPts_forall_mem
statement:
theorem unifPts_forall_mem (T : Finset (Fin n)) (W : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    unifPts n {P | ∀ i ∈ T, P i ∈ W} =
      (volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ × ℝ) 1)) W ^ T.card
proof:
:= by
  
  have hset : {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ | ∀ i ∈ T, P i ∈ W} =
      Set.univ.pi (fun i => if i ∈ T then W else Set.univ) := by
    ext P
    rw [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_univ_pi]
    refine forall_congr' fun i => ?_
    by_cases hi : i ∈ T <;> simp [hi]
  rw [hset, Measure.pi_pi]
  calc ∏ i : Fin n, (volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ × ℝ) 1)) (if i ∈ T then W else Set.univ)
      = ∏ i : Fin n, if i ∈ T then (volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ × ℝ) 1)) W else 1 := by
        refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        split_ifs
        · rfl
        · exact measure_univ
    _ = (volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ × ℝ) 1)) W ^ T.card := by
        rw [Fintype.prod_ite_mem, Finset.prod_const]

name: R56Audit.unifPts_forall_mem_le
statement:
theorem unifPts_forall_mem_le {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) {W : Set (ℝ × ℝ)}
    (hW : (volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ × ℝ) 1)) W ≤ ENNReal.ofReal q)
    {T : Finset (Fin n)} (hT : (n : ℝ) / 2 ≤ T.card) :
    unifPts n {P | ∀ i ∈ T, P i ∈ W} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (q ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  calc unifPts n {P | ∀ i ∈ T, P i ∈ W}
      = (volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ × ℝ) 1)) W ^ T.card := unifPts_forall_mem T W
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal q ^ T.card := pow_le_pow_left' hW _
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (q ^ ((T.card : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_natCast, ENNReal.ofReal_pow hq0.le]
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (q ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)) :=
        ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1 hT)

name: R56Audit.exists_card_eq_ceil_half
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hTsub, hTcard⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq (Nat.ceil_le.mpr hE)
  exact ⟨T, hTcard, fun i hi => (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hTsub hi)).2⟩

name: R56Audit.unifPts_half_mem_le
statement:
theorem unifPts_half_mem_le {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) {W : Set (ℝ × ℝ)}
    (hW : (volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ × ℝ) 1)) W ≤ ENNReal.ofReal q) :
    unifPts n {P | (n : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => P i ∈ W)).card} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 ^ n * q ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  
  let 𝒯 : Finset (Finset (Fin n)) := Finset.univ.filter (fun T => T.card = ⌈(n : ℝ) / 2⌉₊)
  
  have hsub : {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ | (n : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => P i ∈ W)).card} ⊆
      ⋃ T ∈ 𝒯, {P | ∀ i ∈ T, P i ∈ W} := by
    intro P hP
    obtain ⟨T, hT, hTW⟩ := exists_card_eq_ceil_half hP
    exact Set.mem_biUnion (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hT⟩) hTW
  
  have hcard : 𝒯.card ≤ 2 ^ n := by
    calc 𝒯.card ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin n))).card :=
          Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
      _ = 2 ^ n := by rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_finset, Fintype.card_fin]
  calc unifPts n {P | (n : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => P i ∈ W)).card}
      ≤ unifPts n (⋃ T ∈ 𝒯, {P | ∀ i ∈ T, P i ∈ W}) := measure_mono hsub
    _ ≤ ∑ T ∈ 𝒯, unifPts n {P | ∀ i ∈ T, P i ∈ W} := measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _T ∈ 𝒯, ENNReal.ofReal (q ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun T hT => unifPts_forall_mem_le hq0 hq1 hW ?_
        rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hT).2]
        exact Nat.le_ceil _
    _ = (𝒯.card : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal (q ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    _ ≤ ((2 ^ n : ℕ) : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal (q ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)) :=
        mul_le_mul' (Nat.cast_le.mpr hcard) le_rfl
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (2 ^ n * q ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)) := by
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_natCast, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _), Nat.cast_pow,
          Nat.cast_ofNat]

name: R56Audit.unifPts_crowdEvent_le
statement:
theorem unifPts_crowdEvent_le {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 3 ≤ b) (hj : j < h)
    {𝒮 : Finset (Fin (b ^ j) × Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1)))}
    (h𝒮 : (𝒮.card : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / b) :
    unifPts n (crowdEvent b h j 𝒮) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 ^ n * (3 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (3 : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < 3 / (b : ℝ) := by positivity
  
  have hq1 : 3 / (b : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_one (by linarith)]
    exact hbR
  exact unifPts_half_mem_le hq0 hq1 (unitSq_Wset_le (by omega) hj h𝒮)

name: R56Audit.mem_crowdEvent_heavySet
proof:
:=
  (half_lt_card_Wset hb hj hP hbad).le

name: R56Audit.heavySet_mem_smallCollections
statement:
theorem heavySet_mem_smallCollections {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ}
    (hgrid : NoGrid b P) : heavySet b h j P ∈ smallCollections b h j
proof:
:=
  mem_smallCollections.mpr (card_heavySet_lt hb hgrid)

name: R56Audit.bad_subset_iUnion_crowdEvent
statement:
theorem bad_subset_iUnion_crowdEvent {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hj : j < h) :
    {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ | ¬ GoodTransition b h j P} ∩ {P | InUnit P ∧ NoGrid b P} ⊆
      ⋃ 𝒮 ∈ smallCollections b h j, crowdEvent b h j 𝒮
proof:
:= by
  rintro P ⟨hbad, hP, hgrid⟩
  exact Set.mem_biUnion (heavySet_mem_smallCollections hb hgrid)
    (mem_crowdEvent_heavySet hb hj (mem_unit_of_inUnit_of_noGrid hP hgrid) hbad)

name: R56Audit.bad_ae_le_iUnion_crowdEvent
statement:
theorem bad_ae_le_iUnion_crowdEvent {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hj : j < h) :
    {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ | ¬ GoodTransition b h j P} ≤ᵐ[unifPts n]
      ⋃ 𝒮 ∈ smallCollections b h j, crowdEvent b h j 𝒮
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [ae_inUnit n, ae_noGrid n b] with P hP hgrid hbad
  exact bad_subset_iUnion_crowdEvent hb hj ⟨hbad, hP, hgrid⟩

name: R56Audit.card_smallCollections_le
statement:
lemma card_smallCollections_le {b h j : ℕ} (hj : j < h) :
    (smallCollections b h j).card ≤ 2 ^ b ^ (h - 1)
proof:
:= by
  calc (smallCollections b h j).card
      ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin (b ^ j) × Fin (b ^ (h - j - 1))))).card :=
        Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
    _ = 2 ^ b ^ (h - 1) := by rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_finset, card_compRect hj]

name: R56Audit.unifPts_bad_le
statement:
theorem unifPts_bad_le {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 3 ≤ b) (hj : j < h) :
    unifPts n {P | ¬ GoodTransition b h j P} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 ^ (b ^ (h - 1) + n) * (3 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  calc unifPts n {P | ¬ GoodTransition b h j P}
      ≤ unifPts n (⋃ 𝒮 ∈ smallCollections b h j, crowdEvent b h j 𝒮) :=
        measure_mono_ae (bad_ae_le_iUnion_crowdEvent (by omega) hj)
    _ ≤ ∑ 𝒮 ∈ smallCollections b h j, unifPts n (crowdEvent b h j 𝒮) :=
        measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _𝒮 ∈ smallCollections b h j,
          ENNReal.ofReal (2 ^ n * (3 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun 𝒮 h𝒮 => unifPts_crowdEvent_le hb hj (mem_smallCollections.mp h𝒮)
    _ = ((smallCollections b h j).card : ENNReal) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (2 ^ n * (3 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    _ ≤ ((2 ^ b ^ (h - 1) : ℕ) : ENNReal) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (2 ^ n * (3 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)) :=
        mul_le_mul' (Nat.cast_le.mpr (card_smallCollections_le hj)) le_rfl
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (2 ^ (b ^ (h - 1) + n) * (3 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)) := by
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_natCast, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring

name: R56Audit.two_pow_mul_rpow_le
statement:
lemma two_pow_mul_rpow_le {b M : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hMn : M ≤ n) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (M + n) * (3 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) ≤ (48 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  
  have h1 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (M + n) ≤ 4 ^ n := by
    calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (M + n) ≤ 2 ^ (2 * n) := pow_le_pow_right₀ one_le_two (by omega)
      _ = 4 ^ n := by
          rw [pow_mul]
          norm_num
  
  have h2 : (4 : ℝ) ^ n = (16 : ℝ) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) := by
    have h16 : (16 : ℝ) = (4 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_two]
      norm_num
    rw [h16, ← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num), ← Real.rpow_natCast]
    congr 1
    ring
  
  have h3 : (48 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) =
      (16 : ℝ) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) * (3 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) := by
    rw [← Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (by positivity)]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [h3, ← h2]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (by positivity)

name: R56Audit.unifPts_bad_le_rpow
statement:
theorem unifPts_bad_le_rpow {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 3 ≤ b) (hMn : b ^ (h - 1) ≤ n) (hj : j < h) :
    unifPts n {P | ¬ GoodTransition b h j P} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((48 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2))
proof:
:=
  (unifPts_bad_le hb hj).trans
    (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (two_pow_mul_rpow_le (by omega) hMn))

name: R56Audit.lemma_2_5_ii
statement:
theorem lemma_2_5_ii {b h j : ℕ} (hb : 3 ≤ b) (hMn : b ^ (h - 1) ≤ n) (hj : j < h) :
    (unifPts n).real {P | ¬ GoodTransition b h j P} ≤ (48 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)
proof:
:=
  ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (by positivity) (unifPts_bad_le_rpow hb hMn hj)

name: R56Audit.lemma_2_5_ii_all
statement:
theorem lemma_2_5_ii_all {b h : ℕ} (hb : 3 ≤ b) (hMn : b ^ (h - 1) ≤ n) :
    (unifPts n).real {P | ∃ j, j < h ∧ ¬ GoodTransition b h j P} ≤
      h * (48 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hset : {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ | ∃ j, j < h ∧ ¬ GoodTransition b h j P} =
      ⋃ j ∈ Finset.range h, {P | ¬ GoodTransition b h j P} := by
    ext P
    simp
  rw [hset]
  calc (unifPts n).real (⋃ j ∈ Finset.range h, {P | ¬ GoodTransition b h j P})
      ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range h, (unifPts n).real {P | ¬ GoodTransition b h j P} :=
        measureReal_biUnion_finset_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ Finset.range h, (48 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun j hj => lemma_2_5_ii hb hMn (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
    _ = h * (48 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]

name: R56Audit.exists_base_of_15
statement:
lemma exists_base_of_15 (A : ℝ) :
    ∃ b : ℕ, A + 2 ≤ Real.log ((b : ℝ) / 48) / 2 ∧ A + 2 + Real.log 2 ≤ (b : ℝ) / 4096
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_nat_ge
    (max (48 * Real.exp (2 * (A + 2))) (4096 * (A + 2 + Real.log 2)))
  refine ⟨b, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 : 48 * Real.exp (2 * (A + 2)) ≤ b := (le_max_left _ _).trans hb
    have h2 : Real.exp (2 * (A + 2)) ≤ (b : ℝ) / 48 := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]
      linarith
    have h3 := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) h2
    rw [Real.log_exp] at h3
    linarith
  · have h1 : 4096 * (A + 2 + Real.log 2) ≤ b := (le_max_right _ _).trans hb
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]
    linarith

name: R56Audit.base_ge_49
statement:
lemma base_ge_49 {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) {b : ℕ} (hb1 : A + 2 ≤ Real.log ((b : ℝ) / 48) / 2) :
    49 ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < Real.log ((b : ℝ) / 48) := by linarith
  have hq : (1 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) / 48 := by
    by_contra hle
    have := Real.log_nonpos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (b : ℝ) / 48) (not_lt.mp hle)
    linarith
  have h48 : (48 : ℝ) < b := by
    have := (lt_div_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 48)).mp hq
    linarith
  have : (48 : ℕ) < b := by exact_mod_cast h48
  omega

name: R56Audit.sixty_four_le_pow_four
statement: lemma sixty_four_le_pow_four {b : ℕ} (hb : 3 ≤ b) : (64 : ℝ) ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  have hb3 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have h81 : (3 : ℝ) ^ 4 ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ 4 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) hb3 4
  linarith

name: R56Audit.one_add_logb_pos
statement: lemma one_add_logb_pos {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) : 0 < 1 + Real.logb 2 b
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ b by omega)
  have := Real.logb_nonneg (b := 2) (by norm_num) hbR
  linarith

name: R56Audit.cA_pos
statement: lemma cA_pos {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) : 0 < cA b
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < b by omega)
  have hl := one_add_logb_pos hb
  unfold cA
  positivity

name: R56Audit.scaleOK_one
statement: lemma scaleOK_one {b n : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : ScaleOK b n 1
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hnR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have h5 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ 5 := one_le_pow₀ hbR
  unfold ScaleOK
  rw [Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, Nat.cast_one, mul_one]
  exact ((div_le_one (by positivity)).mpr h5).trans hnR

name: R56Audit.le_of_scaleOK
statement: lemma le_of_scaleOK {b n h : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hs : ScaleOK b n h) : h ≤ b ^ 5 * n
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hM : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) := one_le_pow₀ hbR
  have h1 : (h : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) ≤ n * (b : ℝ) ^ 5 :=
    (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).mp hs
  have h2 : (h : ℝ) ≤ (h : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) :=
    le_mul_of_one_le_right (Nat.cast_nonneg h) hM
  have h3 : (h : ℝ) ≤ ((b ^ 5 * n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    push_cast
    linarith
  exact_mod_cast h3

name: R56Audit.exists_isScale
statement: theorem exists_isScale {b n : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : ∃ h, IsScale b n h
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hb1 : 1 ≤ b := by omega
  have h1 : ScaleOK b n 1 := scaleOK_one hb1 hn
  have h1le : 1 ≤ b ^ 5 * n := le_of_scaleOK hb1 h1
  
  exact ⟨Nat.findGreatest (ScaleOK b n) (b ^ 5 * n), Nat.le_findGreatest h1le h1,
    Nat.findGreatest_spec h1le h1,
    fun h' hh' => Nat.le_findGreatest (le_of_scaleOK hb1 hh') hh'⟩

name: R56Audit.lt_of_isScale
statement:
lemma lt_of_isScale {b n h : ℕ} (hs : IsScale b n h) :
    (n : ℝ) < ((h : ℝ) + 1) * (b : ℝ) ^ h / (b : ℝ) ^ 5
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  
  have hok : ScaleOK b n (h + 1) := by
    unfold ScaleOK
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    push_cast
    exact not_lt.mp hcon
  have := hs.2.2 (h + 1) hok
  omega

name: R56Audit.scale_succ_le_two_mul
statement: lemma scale_succ_le_two_mul {h : ℕ} (hh : 1 ≤ h) : (h : ℝ) + 1 ≤ 2 * h
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ h := by exact_mod_cast hh
  linarith

name: R56Audit.base_pow_eq_mul_pow
statement:
lemma base_pow_eq_mul_pow (b : ℕ) {h : ℕ} (hh : 1 ≤ h) :
    (b : ℝ) ^ h = b * (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel hh]

name: R56Audit.display_16
statement:
theorem display_16 {b n h : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hs : IsScale b n h) :
    (h : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / (b : ℝ) ^ 5 ≤ n ∧
      (n : ℝ) < 2 * h * (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / (b : ℝ) ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < b by omega)
  
  refine ⟨hs.2.1, (lt_of_isScale hs).trans_le ?_⟩
  
  have e : ((h : ℝ) + 1) * (b : ℝ) ^ h / (b : ℝ) ^ 5 =
      ((h : ℝ) + 1) * (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / (b : ℝ) ^ 4 := by
    rw [base_pow_eq_mul_pow b hs.1]
    field_simp
  rw [e]
  
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (scale_succ_le_two_mul hs.1) (by positivity)) (by positivity)

name: R56Audit.scale_succ_le_two_pow
statement: lemma scale_succ_le_two_pow (h : ℕ) : (h : ℝ) + 1 ≤ 2 ^ h
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := h)

name: R56Audit.inv_pow_five_le_one
statement: lemma inv_pow_five_le_one {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) : ((b : ℝ) ^ 5)⁻¹ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  exact inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (one_le_pow₀ hbR)

name: R56Audit.lt_two_mul_pow_of_isScale
statement:
lemma lt_two_mul_pow_of_isScale {b n h : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hs : IsScale b n h) :
    (n : ℝ) < (2 * (b : ℝ)) ^ h
proof:
:= by
  
  calc (n : ℝ) < ((h : ℝ) + 1) * (b : ℝ) ^ h / (b : ℝ) ^ 5 := lt_of_isScale hs
    
    _ ≤ ((h : ℝ) + 1) * (b : ℝ) ^ h := by
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity) (inv_pow_five_le_one hb)
    
    _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ h * (b : ℝ) ^ h :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (scale_succ_le_two_pow h) (by positivity)
    _ = (2 * (b : ℝ)) ^ h := (mul_pow _ _ _).symm

name: R56Audit.display_17
statement:
theorem display_17 {b n h : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hs : IsScale b n h) :
    Real.logb 2 n < (1 + Real.logb 2 b) * h
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < b by omega)
  have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < n by omega)
  
  have e : Real.logb 2 ((2 * (b : ℝ)) ^ h) = (1 + Real.logb 2 b) * h := by
    rw [Real.logb_pow, Real.logb_mul (by norm_num) hbR.ne',
      Real.logb_self_eq_one (by norm_num), mul_comm]
  rw [← e]
  
  exact Real.logb_lt_logb (by norm_num) hnR (lt_two_mul_pow_of_isScale (by omega) hs)

name: R56Audit.display_18
statement:
theorem display_18 {b n h : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hs : IsScale b n h) :
    cA b * Real.logb 2 n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) < ((b : ℝ) ^ 8)⁻¹ * (h : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hl : 0 < 1 + Real.logb 2 b := one_add_logb_pos hb
  have hlp : 0 < (1 + Real.logb 2 b) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hl _
  
  have hlog0 : 0 ≤ Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ) := Real.logb_nonneg (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast hn)
  
  have hpow : Real.logb 2 n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) <
      (1 + Real.logb 2 b) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (h : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Real.mul_rpow hl.le (Nat.cast_nonneg h)]
    exact Real.rpow_lt_rpow hlog0 (display_17 hb hn hs) (by norm_num)
  
  calc cA b * Real.logb 2 n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)
      < cA b * ((1 + Real.logb 2 b) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (h : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hpow (cA_pos hb)
    _ = ((b : ℝ) ^ 8)⁻¹ * (h : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by
        unfold cA
        rw [← mul_assoc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hlp.ne']

name: R56Audit.scale_div_pow_five_lt_one
statement:
lemma scale_div_pow_five_lt_one {b n h : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hs : IsScale b n h)
    (hMn : n < b ^ (h - 1)) : (h : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ 5 < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < b by omega)
  have hM : (0 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) := by positivity
  have hnM : (n : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) := by exact_mod_cast hMn
  
  have h1 : (h : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ 5 * (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) < 1 * (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) := by
    rw [one_mul, div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    exact (display_16 hb hs).1.trans_lt hnM
  exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right h1 hM.le

name: R56Audit.scale_lt_pow_five
statement:
lemma scale_lt_pow_five {b n h : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hs : IsScale b n h)
    (hMn : n < b ^ (h - 1)) : (h : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ 5
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < b by omega)
  exact (div_lt_one (by positivity)).mp (scale_div_pow_five_lt_one hb hs hMn)

name: R56Audit.cA_mul_lt_of_lt
statement:
lemma cA_mul_lt_of_lt {b n h : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hs : IsScale b n h)
    (hMn : n < b ^ (h - 1)) :
    cA b * Real.logb 2 n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) < ((b : ℝ) ^ 8)⁻¹ * (b : ℝ) ^ (15 / 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < b by omega)
  have hb8 : (0 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ 8 := by positivity
  
  have h152 : (h : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ (15 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    have h1 := Real.rpow_lt_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg h) (scale_lt_pow_five hb hs hMn)
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3 / 2)
    rwa [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hb0.le,
      show ((5 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (3 / 2) = 15 / 2 by norm_num] at h1
  
  calc cA b * Real.logb 2 n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)
      < ((b : ℝ) ^ 8)⁻¹ * (h : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) := display_18 hb hn hs
    _ < ((b : ℝ) ^ 8)⁻¹ * (b : ℝ) ^ (15 / 2 : ℝ) :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h152 (inv_pos.mpr hb8)

name: R56Audit.inv_pow_eight_mul_rpow_lt_one
statement:
lemma inv_pow_eight_mul_rpow_lt_one {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) :
    ((b : ℝ) ^ 8)⁻¹ * (b : ℝ) ^ (15 / 2 : ℝ) < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hb1 : (1 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < b by omega)
  have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) < b := by linarith
  have hb8 : (0 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ 8 := by positivity
  
  have h8 : (b : ℝ) ^ (15 / 2 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ 8 := by
    have h1 := Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt hb1 (by norm_num : (15 / 2 : ℝ) < (8 : ℕ))
    rwa [Real.rpow_natCast] at h1
  calc ((b : ℝ) ^ 8)⁻¹ * (b : ℝ) ^ (15 / 2 : ℝ)
      < ((b : ℝ) ^ 8)⁻¹ * (b : ℝ) ^ 8 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h8 (inv_pos.mpr hb8)
    _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hb8.ne'

name: R56Audit.cA_mul_lt_one
statement:
theorem cA_mul_lt_one {b n h : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hs : IsScale b n h)
    (hMn : n < b ^ (h - 1)) : cA b * Real.logb 2 n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) < 1
proof:
:=
  calc cA b * Real.logb 2 n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)
      < ((b : ℝ) ^ 8)⁻¹ * (b : ℝ) ^ (15 / 2 : ℝ) := cA_mul_lt_of_lt hb hn hs hMn
    _ < 1 := inv_pow_eight_mul_rpow_lt_one hb

name: R56Audit.ae_one_le_supNorm
statement:
theorem ae_one_le_supNorm {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∀ᵐ P ∂unifPts n, ∀ χ : Fin n → ℤˣ, 1 ≤ supNorm χ P
proof:
:= by
  
  filter_upwards [ae_heights_injective n, ae_inUnit n] with P hinj hunit χ
  exact one_le_supNorm hn χ P
    (fun i => ⟨⟨(hunit i).1.1.le, (hunit i).1.2⟩, ⟨(hunit i).2.1.le, (hunit i).2.2⟩⟩) hinj

name: R56Audit.ae_cA_mul_lt_supNorm
statement:
theorem ae_cA_mul_lt_supNorm {b n h : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hs : IsScale b n h)
    (hMn : n < b ^ (h - 1)) :
    ∀ᵐ P ∂unifPts n, ∀ χ : Fin n → ℤˣ, cA b * Real.logb 2 n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) < supNorm χ P
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have hlt : cA b * Real.logb 2 n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) < 1 := cA_mul_lt_one hb hn hs hMn
  
  filter_upwards [ae_one_le_supNorm hn] with P hP χ
  exact hlt.trans_le (hP χ)

name: R56Audit.scale_le_two_pow
statement: lemma scale_le_two_pow (h : ℕ) : h ≤ 2 ^ (h - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : h - 1 < 2 ^ (h - 1) := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
  omega

name: R56Audit.two_pow_le_base_pow
statement: lemma two_pow_le_base_pow {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (h : ℕ) : 2 ^ (h - 1) ≤ b ^ (h - 1)
proof:
:=
  Nat.pow_le_pow_left hb _

name: R56Audit.scale_le_of_pow_le
statement: lemma scale_le_of_pow_le {b n h : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hMn : b ^ (h - 1) ≤ n) : h ≤ n
proof:
:=
  calc h ≤ 2 ^ (h - 1) := scale_le_two_pow h
    _ ≤ b ^ (h - 1) := two_pow_le_base_pow hb h
    _ ≤ n := hMn

name: R56Audit.first_term_le
statement:
lemma first_term_le {A : ℝ} {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hb1 : A + 2 ≤ Real.log ((b : ℝ) / 48) / 2)
    (n : ℕ) : (48 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) ≤ Real.exp (-(A + 2) * n)
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  
  have hlog : Real.log (48 / (b : ℝ)) = -Real.log ((b : ℝ) / 48) := by
    rw [← Real.log_inv, inv_div]
  have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb1 (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n)
  
  rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by positivity), Real.exp_le_exp, hlog]
  linarith

name: R56Audit.first_term_le_mul
statement:
lemma first_term_le_mul {A : ℝ} {b n h : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hb1 : A + 2 ≤ Real.log ((b : ℝ) / 48) / 2) (hMn : b ^ (h - 1) ≤ n) :
    (h : ℝ) * (48 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) ≤ h * Real.exp (-(A + 2) * n) ∧
      (h : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(A + 2) * n) ≤ n * Real.exp (-(A + 2) * n)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (first_term_le (by omega) hb1 n) (Nat.cast_nonneg h),
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Real.exp_pos _).le⟩
  
  exact_mod_cast scale_le_of_pow_le hb hMn

name: R56Audit.exponent_gt
statement:
lemma exponent_gt {b n h : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hs : IsScale b n h) :
    (b : ℝ) * n / 4096 < (h : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / (2048 * (b : ℝ) ^ 3)
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < b by omega)
  
  have e : (h : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / (2048 * (b : ℝ) ^ 3) =
      (b : ℝ) * (2 * h * (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / (b : ℝ) ^ 4) / 4096 := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [e]
  
  exact div_lt_div_of_pos_right (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (display_16 hb hs).2 hbR)
    (by norm_num)

name: R56Audit.exponent_ge
statement:
lemma exponent_ge {A : ℝ} {b : ℕ} (hb2 : A + 2 + Real.log 2 ≤ (b : ℝ) / 4096) (n : ℕ) :
    (A + 2 + Real.log 2) * n ≤ (b : ℝ) * n / 4096
proof:
:= by
  have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb2 (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n)
  linarith

name: R56Audit.second_term_le_two_pow_mul
statement:
lemma second_term_le_two_pow_mul {A : ℝ} {b n h : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hb2 : A + 2 + Real.log 2 ≤ (b : ℝ) / 4096) (hs : IsScale b n h) :
    2 ^ n * Real.exp (-((h : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / (2048 * (b : ℝ) ^ 3))) ≤
      2 ^ n * Real.exp (-(A + 2 + Real.log 2) * n)
proof:
:= by
  
  have h1 := exponent_gt hb hs
  have h2 := exponent_ge hb2 n
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_) (by positivity)
  linarith

name: R56Audit.two_pow_mul_exp_eq
statement:
lemma two_pow_mul_exp_eq (A : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    2 ^ n * Real.exp (-(A + 2 + Real.log 2) * n) = Real.exp (-(A + 2) * n)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ n = Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * Real.log 2) := by
    rw [Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_log (by norm_num)]
  rw [hpow, ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  ring

name: R56Audit.second_term_le
statement:
lemma second_term_le {A : ℝ} {b n h : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hb2 : A + 2 + Real.log 2 ≤ (b : ℝ) / 4096) (hs : IsScale b n h) :
    2 ^ n * Real.exp (-((h : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / (2048 * (b : ℝ) ^ 3))) ≤
      Real.exp (-(A + 2) * n)
proof:
:=
  calc (2 : ℝ) ^ n * Real.exp (-((h : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / (2048 * (b : ℝ) ^ 3)))
      ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n * Real.exp (-(A + 2 + Real.log 2) * n) :=
        second_term_le_two_pow_mul hb hb2 hs
    _ = Real.exp (-(A + 2) * n) := two_pow_mul_exp_eq A n

name: R56Audit.sum_terms_le
statement:
lemma sum_terms_le {A : ℝ} {b n h : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hb1 : A + 2 ≤ Real.log ((b : ℝ) / 48) / 2) (hb2 : A + 2 + Real.log 2 ≤ (b : ℝ) / 4096)
    (hs : IsScale b n h) (hMn : b ^ (h - 1) ≤ n) :
    h * (48 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) +
        2 ^ n * Real.exp (-((h : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / (2048 * (b : ℝ) ^ 3))) ≤
      ((n : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (-(A + 2) * n)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hfirst := first_term_le_mul hb hb1 hMn
  
  have hsecond := second_term_le hb hb2 hs
  calc (h : ℝ) * (48 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) +
        2 ^ n * Real.exp (-((h : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / (2048 * (b : ℝ) ^ 3)))
      ≤ n * Real.exp (-(A + 2) * n) + Real.exp (-(A + 2) * n) :=
        add_le_add (hfirst.1.trans hfirst.2) hsecond
    _ = ((n : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (-(A + 2) * n) := by ring

name: R56Audit.add_one_le_exp_two_mul
statement: lemma add_one_le_exp_two_mul {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : x + 1 ≤ Real.exp (2 * x)
proof:
:=
  (Real.add_one_le_exp x).trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (le_mul_of_one_le_left hx one_le_two))

name: R56Audit.add_one_mul_exp_le
statement:
lemma add_one_mul_exp_le (A : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    (x + 1) * Real.exp (-(A + 2) * x) ≤ Real.exp (-A * x)
proof:
:=
  calc (x + 1) * Real.exp (-(A + 2) * x)
      ≤ Real.exp (2 * x) * Real.exp (-(A + 2) * x) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (add_one_le_exp_two_mul hx) (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = Real.exp (-A * x) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        congr 1
        ring

name: R56Audit.failure_le
statement:
theorem failure_le {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) {b n h : ℕ}
    (hb1 : A + 2 ≤ Real.log ((b : ℝ) / 48) / 2) (hb2 : A + 2 + Real.log 2 ≤ (b : ℝ) / 4096)
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hs : IsScale b n h) (hMn : b ^ (h - 1) ≤ n) :
    h * (48 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) +
        2 ^ n * Real.exp (-((h : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / (2048 * (b : ℝ) ^ 3))) ≤
      Real.exp (-A * n)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hb49 : 49 ≤ b := base_ge_49 hA hb1
  
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := zero_le_one.trans (by exact_mod_cast hn)
  calc (h : ℝ) * (48 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) +
        2 ^ n * Real.exp (-((h : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / (2048 * (b : ℝ) ^ 3)))
      ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (-(A + 2) * n) := sum_terms_le (by omega) hb1 hb2 hs hMn
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-A * n) := add_one_mul_exp_le A hn0

name: R56Audit.threshold_ge_sqrt
statement:
lemma threshold_ge_sqrt {b n h : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hs : IsScale b n h) :
    (h : ℝ) / (64 * (b : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (h / (b : ℝ) ^ 5) ≤
      (h : ℝ) / (64 * (b : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (n / (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < b by omega)
  have hM : (0 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) := by positivity
  
  have hroot : Real.sqrt (h / (b : ℝ) ^ 5) ≤ Real.sqrt (n / (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1)) := by
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hM]
    calc (h : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ 5 * (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1)
        = (h : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / (b : ℝ) ^ 5 := by ring
      _ ≤ (n : ℝ) := (display_16 hb hs).1
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hroot (by positivity)

name: R56Audit.threshold_sqrt_eq
statement:
lemma threshold_sqrt_eq (b h : ℕ) :
    (h : ℝ) / (64 * (b : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (h / (b : ℝ) ^ 5) =
      (h : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) / (64 * (b : ℝ) ^ 4)
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ b := Nat.cast_nonneg b
  have hh0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ h := Nat.cast_nonneg h
  have hsbb : Real.sqrt b * Real.sqrt b = b := Real.mul_self_sqrt hb0
  
  have e5 : Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) ^ 5) = (b : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt b := by
    rw [show (b : ℝ) ^ 5 = ((b : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ 2 * b by ring, Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity),
      Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]
  
  have e4 : (64 : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ 4 =
      64 * ((b : ℝ) * Real.sqrt b) * ((b : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt b) := by
    calc (64 : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ 4 = 64 * (b : ℝ) ^ 3 * b := by ring
      _ = 64 * (b : ℝ) ^ 3 * (Real.sqrt b * Real.sqrt b) := by rw [hsbb]
      _ = 64 * ((b : ℝ) * Real.sqrt b) * ((b : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt b) := by ring
  
  rw [Real.sqrt_div' _ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ 5), e5,
    rpow_three_halves_eq_mul_sqrt hb0, rpow_three_halves_eq_mul_sqrt hh0, e4,
    div_mul_div_comm]

name: R56Audit.rpow_div_ge
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < b by omega)
  
  have h64 : (64 : ℝ) ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ 4 := sixty_four_le_pow_four hb
  rw [inv_mul_eq_div]
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg h) _) (by positivity)
  nlinarith [pow_pos hb0 4]

name: R56Audit.threshold_gt
statement:
theorem threshold_gt {b n h : ℕ} (hb : 3 ≤ b) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hs : IsScale b n h) :
    cA b * Real.logb 2 n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) <
      (h : ℝ) / (64 * (b : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (n / (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1))
proof:
:=
  
  calc cA b * Real.logb 2 n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)
      < ((b : ℝ) ^ 8)⁻¹ * (h : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) := display_18 (by omega) hn hs
    _ ≤ (h : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) / (64 * (b : ℝ) ^ 4) := rpow_div_ge hb h
    _ = (h : ℝ) / (64 * (b : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (h / (b : ℝ) ^ 5) :=
        (threshold_sqrt_eq b h).symm
    _ ≤ (h : ℝ) / (64 * (b : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (n / (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1)) :=
        threshold_ge_sqrt (by omega) hs

name: R56Audit.prob_exists_supNorm_le_of_pow_le
statement:
theorem prob_exists_supNorm_le_of_pow_le {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) {b n h : ℕ}
    (hb1 : A + 2 ≤ Real.log ((b : ℝ) / 48) / 2) (hb2 : A + 2 + Real.log 2 ≤ (b : ℝ) / 4096)
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hs : IsScale b n h) (hMn : b ^ (h - 1) ≤ n) :
    (unifPts n).real {P | ∃ χ : Fin n → ℤˣ, supNorm χ P ≤ cA b * Real.logb 2 n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)} ≤
      Real.exp (-A * n)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hb49 : 49 ≤ b := base_ge_49 hA hb1
  
  have hsub : {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ | ∃ χ : Fin n → ℤˣ,
        supNorm χ P ≤ cA b * Real.logb 2 n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)} ⊆
      {P | ∃ χ : Fin n → ℤˣ, supNorm χ P ≤
        (h : ℝ) / (64 * (b : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (n / (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1))} :=
    fun P ⟨χ, hχ⟩ => ⟨χ, hχ.trans (threshold_gt (by omega) hn hs).le⟩
  calc (unifPts n).real {P | ∃ χ : Fin n → ℤˣ,
        supNorm χ P ≤ cA b * Real.logb 2 n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)}
      ≤ (unifPts n).real {P | ∃ χ : Fin n → ℤˣ, supNorm χ P ≤
          (h : ℝ) / (64 * (b : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (n / (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1))} :=
        measureReal_mono hsub
    
    _ ≤ h * (48 / (b : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) +
          2 ^ n * Real.exp (-((h : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ (h - 1) / (2048 * (b : ℝ) ^ 3))) :=
        proposition_2_7 (by omega) hs.1 hMn
    
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-A * n) := failure_le hA hb1 hb2 hn hs hMn

name: R56Audit.prob_exists_supNorm_le
statement:
theorem prob_exists_supNorm_le {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) {b : ℕ}
    (hb1 : A + 2 ≤ Real.log ((b : ℝ) / 48) / 2) (hb2 : A + 2 + Real.log 2 ≤ (b : ℝ) / 4096)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (unifPts n).real {P | ∃ χ : Fin n → ℤˣ, supNorm χ P ≤ cA b * Real.logb 2 n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)} ≤
      Real.exp (-A * n)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hb49 : 49 ≤ b := base_ge_49 hA hb1
  
  obtain ⟨h, hs⟩ := exists_isScale (by omega : 2 ≤ b) hn
  rcases lt_or_ge n (b ^ (h - 1)) with hMn | hMn
  · 
    
    have hnull : unifPts n {P | ∃ χ : Fin n → ℤˣ,
        supNorm χ P ≤ cA b * Real.logb 2 n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)} = 0 := by
      refine measure_mono_null ?_ (ae_iff.mp (ae_cA_mul_lt_supNorm (by omega) hn hs hMn))
      rintro P ⟨χ, hχ⟩ hall
      exact absurd (hall χ) (not_lt.mpr hχ)
    rw [measureReal_def, hnull, ENNReal.toReal_zero]
    exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
  · 
    exact prob_exists_supNorm_le_of_pow_le hA hb1 hb2 hn hs hMn

name: R56Audit.measurableSet_distinct_Icc_forall_lt_supNorm
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : MeasurableSet {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ | ∀ i j, i ≠ j → P i ≠ P j} := by
    have e : {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ | ∀ i j, i ≠ j → P i ≠ P j} =
        ⋂ i, ⋂ j, ⋂ _ : i ≠ j, {P | P i = P j}ᶜ := by
      ext P
      simp
    rw [e]
    exact MeasurableSet.iInter fun i => MeasurableSet.iInter fun j =>
      MeasurableSet.iInter fun _ =>
        (measurableSet_eq_fun (measurable_pi_apply i) (measurable_pi_apply j)).compl
  have h2 : MeasurableSet {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ | ∀ i, P i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ × ℝ) 1} := by
    have e : {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ | ∀ i, P i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ × ℝ) 1} =
        ⋂ i, (fun P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ => P i) ⁻¹' Set.Icc 0 1 := by
      ext P
      simp
    rw [e]
    exact MeasurableSet.iInter fun i => measurable_pi_apply i measurableSet_Icc
  have h3 : MeasurableSet {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ | ∀ χ : Fin n → ℤˣ, t < supNorm χ P} := by
    have e : {P : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ | ∀ χ : Fin n → ℤˣ, t < supNorm χ P} =
        ⋂ χ : Fin n → ℤˣ, {P | t < supNorm χ P} := by
      ext P
      simp
    rw [e]
    exact MeasurableSet.iInter fun χ => measurableSet_lt measurable_const (measurable_supNorm χ)
  exact h1.inter (h2.inter h3)
